line: Those soldiers have formed a skirmishing line, I think you'd call it, and they're headed this way.

title: Hide and Q
line: Muskets are appropriate to the 1790 to 1800 French army uniform, sir. But it is hardly a weapon by our standards. A lead ball propelled by gunpowder. One hundred meters at best with any accuracy.

title: Hide and Q
line: I wish I knew. Q first became interested in him at Farpoint. I have no idea what it means. Meanwhile, we must proceed with our rescue mission.

line: Something amuses you? Perhaps you'll share the joke with me?

title: Hide and Q
line: The joke is you.

title: Hide and Q
line: Strange gratitude, from one who has been granted a gift beyond any human dream. How can you not appreciate being able to send your friends back to their ship, or sending the soldiers back to the nothingness from which they came? title: Hide and Q
line: What do you need, Q?

title: Hide and Q
line: Need?

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: Want something from you foolish, fragile, non-entities? Oh come, Riker. You're beginning to sound like your Captain.

title: Hide and Q
line: Now that's a compliment, Q. But that's not an answer.

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: Out of the goodness of your heart.

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: The Bridge will be fine, since I've called the entire staff.

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: Of course, Jean-Luc.

title: Hide and Q
line: Wesley, this meeting is not for you.

title: Hide and Q
line: Why not, sir? You helped make me a Bridge officer. Acting Ensign.

title: Hide and Q
line: All right, he stays. Because I've been given unusual powers, I am not suddenly a monster. Except for these abilities, and I don't yet know how far they go, I'm the same William T. Riker you've always known. Well? Everyone still looks uncomfortable.

title: Hide and Q
line: Perhaps they're all remembering that old saying. Power corrupts.

title: Hide and Q
line: And absolute power corrupts absolutely. Do you believe I haven't thought of that, Jean-Luc?

title: Hide and Q
line: And have you noticed how you and I are now on a first name basis? Number One, Will, something has happened already.

title: Hide and Q
line: In what way? Haven't you seen how much I regretted not saving that child? Using the Q power to save her may not have been wrong. No more than it was wrong to save the rest of you from those soldier things.

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: What we represent to the Q, Commander, are lowly animals, tormented into performing for their amusement.

title: Hide and Q
line: Actually, they think highly of us, Tasha. We have a quality of growth which they admire.

title: Hide and Q
line: Or fear.

title: Hide and Q
line: No, we've learned the Q do not admire us. The Q has muddled your mind.

title: Hide and Q
line: Don't you understand his incredible gift to me?

title: Hide and Q
line: Are these truly your friends, brother?

title: Hide and Q
line: Let us pray. For understanding and for compassion.

title: Hide and Q
line: Let us do no such damned thing! What is this need of yours for costumes, Q? Have you no identity of your own?

title: Hide and Q
line: I come in search of the truth.

title: Hide and Q
line: You come in search of what humanity is!

title: Hide and Q
line: I forgive your blasphemy.

title: Hide and Q
line: Don't you see, Riker? He's nothing but a flim-flam man! He's been that ever since we first met him at Farpoint.

title: Hide and Q
line: Flim-flam?

title: Hide and Q
line: You offer Riker jealousy. What I offer him is clearly beyond your comprehension. How can you claim friendship for Riker while obstructing his way to the greatest adventure ever offered a human?

title: Hide and Q
line: Obstructing him? Then it's not yet certain. He's not yet committed.

title: Hide and Q
line: The truly evil part of this, Captain, is your jealousy. You love each one of your people. Demonstrate it. You have the power to leave each of them with a gift proving your affection.

title: Hide and Q
line: There'd be no harm, would there, if I gave them something I know they'd like?

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: I don't think so, sir. The price is a little high for me, and I don't like who I would have to thank. Make me the way I was. Please!

title: Hide and Q
line: Proud warrior Worf, without a single tie to his own kind.

title: Hide and Q
line: No! She is from a world now alien to me!

title: Hide and Q

title: Hide and Q
line: No place, micro-brain? What possesses you?

title: Hide and Q
line: Commander Riker, it's too soon for this.

title: Hide and Q
line: If this is because your mother objects?

title: Hide and Q
line: No. I just want to get there on my own. Honest.

title: Hide and Q
line: But it's easier, boy. Listen to Riker.

title: Hide and Q
line: How did you know, sir? I feel like such an idiot.

title: Hide and Q
line: Quite right. So you should. It's all over, Q. You have no further business here.

title: Hide and Q
line: Human, you have just destroyed yourself.

title: Hide and Q
line: Pay off your wager.

title: Hide and Q
line: I recall no wager!

title: Hide and Q
line: I'm sure your fellow Q remember you agreed to never trouble our species again. Just as they're aware you failed to tempt a human to join you.

title: Hide and Q
line: No, if I could just do one more thing.

title: Hide and Q
line: Q, I strongly suspect it's some explaining you have to do now.

title: Hide and Q
line: Extraordinary!

title: The Big Goodbye
line: If you were going to go through yourself, sir, that is not possible.

title: The Big Goodbye
line: One look at you, sir, is proof that anything is possible. Step back, Mister Hill. I'd shoot you myself, but I don't want to deprive my assistant of his greatest pleasure. After we've gone, kill them all. Make sure the bodies are never found.

title: The Big Goodbye
line: You're insane. You think you can kill a cop and get away with it?

line: Why not? I've done it before. Come on, Mister Leech. Au revoir et bonne chance, mon ami. Our destiny awaits.

title: The Big Goodbye

title: The Big Goodbye
line: What is this? What are they doing? They can't do this to me! Don't they know who I am? I'm Cyrus Redblock! Cyrus Redblock!

title: The Big Goodbye
line: With your permission, sir?

line: Permission granted.

title: The Big Goodbye
line: Data, pick up Whalen. Take him to Sickbay.

line: And you, sir?

title: The Big Goodbye
line: I'll follow. You go now.

title: The Big Goodbye
line: I wish I could take you with me.

title: The Big Goodbye
line: Someone has to book this creep. Once a cop always a cop, I guess.

title: The Big Goodbye
line: I have to go.

line: So this is the big goodbye. Tell me something, Dixon. When you've gone. will this world still exist? Will my wife and kids still be waiting for me at home?

title: The Big Goodbye

title: The Big Goodbye
line: You have honored us with your words of greeting. A new day dawns between us.

line: So, did you have a nice vacation?

title: Datalore
line: Captain's log, stardate 41242.4. Our last assignment has taken us into the remote Omicron Theta star system, home of our android crewmember Lieutenant Commander Data. Although we are due at our next assignment, I have decided to visit Data's home planet for a few hours in the hopes of unraveling some of the mystery of his beginnings.

title: Datalore
line: Sir, we are now twenty minutes from Omicron Theta, mark!

title: Datalore
line: Stand by for subwarp. Head for standard orbit of Data's planet. I wonder why Data hasn't come up here.

title: Datalore
line: He said he wanted to be alone. Perhaps it's a bigger moment for him than we thought.

title: Datalore
line: Aah, ahh, ahh

title: Datalore
line: Data!

title: Datalore
line: Choo!

title: Datalore
line: What are you doing?

title: Datalore
line: Sneezing.

title: Datalore
line: Have you got a cold?

title: Datalore
line: A cold what?

title: Datalore
line: It's a disease my mom says people used to get.

title: Datalore
line: Ah. But humans still sneeze for other reasons and I cannot seem to do it right.

title: Datalore
line: How can you be practicing something like sneezing when we're arriving at your home planet for the first time? Aren't you interested in that?

title: Datalore
line: More than interested. Fascinated. One might say agog. But I also find sneezing interesting.

title: Datalore
line: Captain Picard wishes to see you on the Bridge.

title: Datalore
line: Captain, confirming class M reading there. But the sensors aren't showing any life readings. Not even vegetation.

title: Datalore
line: Strange. The cruiser that found Data reported farmlands here.

title: Datalore
line: Do you want to take her into orbit, Data?

title: Datalore
line: No, thank you, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Continue on into close parking orbit.

title: Datalore
line: Aye, sir.

title: Datalore
line: I could say home sweet home, sir, if I understood how the word sweet applies.

title: Datalore
line: It usually refers to the memories.

title: Datalore
line: It usually refers to one's own memories, Captain. Do the memories you were given include farms, Data?

title: Datalore
line: Affirmative, sir. But the colony's principal interest was science.

title: Datalore
line: Data, I can't understand how you can hold the memories of four hundred and eleven people. If that means every experience, every day of their life?

title: Datalore
line: It does not, unfortunately. It means only the knowledge they had accumulated. Actually, I am quite deficient in some basic human information. Sneezing, for example.

title: Datalore
line: Sneezing?

title: Datalore
line: Approaching close parking orbit, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Assemble your away party, Commander. This must be an exciting moment for you, Mister Data. I'm tempted to lead the away team myself, except that my First Officer would object.

title: Datalore
line: How would Starfleet judge me if I didn't? An entire Earth colony did disappear down there.

title: Datalore
line: You see?

title: Datalore
line: Now in close parking orbit, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Mister Data, welcome home. First Officer's log, stardate 4124.5. We have found Data's home to be a completely dead world made out of lifeless vegetation. No insects, not even soil bacteria. What is it that could kill everything on an entire planet?

title: Datalore
line: Recording signal locked onto the Enterprise, sir.

title: Datalore
line: This looks like anything but farmland.

title: Datalore
line: Agreed, sir. The soil appears almost completely lifeless.

title: Datalore
line: This is the exact position listed in the Tripoli log. Do you recognize anything, Data?

title: Datalore
line: The land contours are familiar, sir. Topographically, this is the correct area.

title: Datalore
line: This once was rich farmland. I'd say something like twenty to thirty years ago.

title: Datalore
line: I was discovered twenty six years ago.

title: Datalore
line: Commander, I'd say that everything on this planet was either dead or dying at the time Data was found.

title: Datalore
line: I was found twenty meters in that direction, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Data, any idea at all why you were given the colonists' memories?

title: Datalore
line: I have always felt that it was done hurriedly, but I know little more. Here, sir. This is where the cruiser's landing party found the signal device that had led them here. And they found me lying there, sir.

title: Datalore
line: You were just lying out there in the open? No identity record, no instructions?

title: Datalore
line: Only a layer of dust.

title: Datalore
line: What's the first thing you remember, Data?

title: Datalore
line: Opening my eyes. Looking into the eyes of the Tripoli landing party. They believed that the signal device sensed their presence and activated me.

title: Datalore
line: Then this very spot was your birthplace.

title: Datalore
line: Commander, I think I've got this place figured out here. This was really very cleverly done to make this look like a natural hollow in the terrain here. There are signs of it being constructed in a hurry as if to hide something here.

title: Datalore
line: Yes, that was it, Geordi. This wakens a memory remnant of how the colonists hoped to remain hidden, but their fear of being discovered led to their storing information in me.

title: Datalore
line: Yeah, thought so.

title: Datalore
line: No life readings in here either, sir.

title: Datalore
line: The colony laboratory. Extremely well equipped. Does this stir any memories, Data?

title: Datalore
line: Only a vague impression of some of my functions being tested here.

title: Datalore
line: Posted by proud parents?

title: Datalore
line: It depicts something that feels familiar, sir. And dangerous. But I have no idea what it represents. And that is all. Except for an impression of this being a Doctor Soong's work area.

title: Datalore
line: Who? You don't mean Doctor Noonien Soong?

title: Datalore
line: He was called that here, but his memories indicate he traveled here under a different name.

title: Datalore
line: Doctor Noonien Soong, my friend, happens to have been Earth's foremost robotics scientist.

title: Datalore
line: Until he tried to make Asimov's dream of a positronic brain come true.

title: Datalore
line: A positronic brain. He promised so much. And then when he failed completely, Doctor Soong disappeared. Now we know he went somewhere else to try a second time. Data, Geordi, we'll get a close look at this lab. You and Lieutenant Worf reconnoiter where these corridors lead.

title: Datalore
line: Aye, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Data, it's you.

title: Datalore
line: An epidermal mold. Made to give your exterior the desired finish.

title: Datalore
line: Lieutenant Yar to Commander Riker.

title: Datalore
line: Come in, Lieutenant.

title: Datalore
line: Sir, this installation is big enough to hold hundreds of people. But all that's here now is empty beds.

title: Datalore
line: Thank you, Lieutenant. Complete your record scans and report back here.

title: Datalore
line: Commander Riker, looks like some sort of storage area.

title: Datalore
line: How many more Datas are there?

title: Datalore
line: Looks like just these two. I mean, that and the real Data.

title: Datalore
line: Commander, can this be another me? Or possibly my brother?

title: Datalore
line: I honestly don't know, Data.

title: Datalore
line: He needs assembling.

title: Datalore
line: He? Data, we don't know that this can become alive.

title: Datalore
line: It is very important for me to know that, sir. I never dreamed it was possible I might find some link with some form like my own.

title: Datalore
line: Understood. We'll take it back to the ship with us.

title: Datalore
line: Captain's log, Stardate 41242.45. Despite having only a few hours in which to explore Data's home planet we've discovered something which may explain Data's beginnings, if we can properly assemble and communicate with what we've found.

title: Datalore
line: Signal from the Captain. They need you at the debriefing.

title: Datalore
line: I've been most anxious to hear the Chief Engineer's opinion, Mister Argyle. Do you believe he can be made to function?

title: Datalore
line: It appears to include all the components in your body. Not that we fully understand your construction either.

title: Datalore
line: We have our top specialists working on its construction, Mister Data.

title: Datalore
line: Just one thing. Without disassembling you, of course, if we should need more

title: Datalore
line: If we should need to compare this with the way you're put together?

title: Datalore
line: Bringing it up here was the right thing to do, Number One. We were just saying, Data, that if your duplicate functions, it might answer a lot of questions.

title: Datalore
line: Does it appear to have all your parts?

title: Datalore
line: Completely, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Will we know how to turn it on?

title: Datalore
line: All right, all right. Legitimate questions about any of this need not be asked apologetically. You feel uncomfortable about aspects of your duplicate, Data. We feel uncomfortable too, and for no logical reason. If it feels awkward to be reminded that Data is a machine, just remember that we are merely a different variety of machine. In our case, electrochemical in nature. Let's begin to handle this as we would do anything else.

title: Datalore
line: Agreed, Captain.

title: Datalore
line: Let's begin with you, Data.

title: Datalore
line: Well, sir, a good starting point may be, why was I given human form?

title: Datalore
line: Well, to make it easier for humans to relate to you. Had to be. But your designer may have had something else to prove as well.

title: Datalore
line: That human-shaped robots need not be clumsy or limited. You certainly operate as well as we do, Data

title: Datalore
line: Better in some ways, sir.

title: Datalore
line: You might want to have a look at this, Captain. Could be a link to the disappearance of the colonists. It was displayed in the lab, no doubt by proud parents. It could be just a child's imagination, but several children did similar drawings.

title: Datalore
line: Doctor Crusher to Captain. At this point, sir, we very much need Mister Data's help.

title: Datalore
line: He's on his way, Doctor.

title: Datalore
line: Press your fingers there, Doctor. There. It operates almost as a switch.

title: Datalore
line: And these small projections?

title: Datalore
line: An android alarm clock. Is that amusing? They time how long I remain unconscious.

title: Datalore
line: Are you certain about us using these heating devices, Data?

title: Datalore
line: I will feel nothing at all.

title: Datalore
line: Marvelous. It should all be a lot simpler once we can see how your circuitry's connected.

title: Datalore
line: I won't mention it to anyone. You have my word.

title: Datalore
line: If you had an off switch Doctor, would you not keep it secret?

title: Datalore
line: I guess I would.

title: Datalore
line: Notice the micro-circuitry here and here. And another fibroid-like connection here.

title: Datalore
line: Let's close up.

title: Datalore
line: It seemed to go well, thanks to a look inside Mister Data. But there have been no signs of consciousness, yet

title: Datalore
line: It certainly is a good match for Data, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Do you think so, really? I wonder which of them was made first?

title: Datalore
line: He was. But they found him imperfect and I was made to replace him. You may call me Lore.

title: Datalore
line: I'm also a bit troubled by it describing you as imperfect.

title: Datalore
line: Human language gives me difficulty too, sir. Imperfect could mean I lack certain abilities he possesses.

title: Datalore
line: I wonder. But the point of this is, whether you and it have approximately the same capabilities.

title: Datalore
line: We do, sir, and your referring to him as an it suggests that I, too, fit into the category of a thing.

title: Datalore
line: I see your point. My apologies.

title: Datalore
line: Gladly accepted, sir. As for Lore's abilities, his use of syntax and grammar suggests he was given human memories similar to my own.

title: Datalore
line: And you have about equal physical strength and mental abilities?

title: Datalore
line: I believe so, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Which requires I now ask you a very serious question. Since the two of you are closely related to each other.

title: Datalore
line: The answer, sir, is that my loyalty is to you and Starfleet. Completely.

title: Datalore
line: Thank you, Commander. I was certain of that.

title: Datalore
line: And helm control is here, with the ship's heading given in measurements we call degrees. Three hundred and sixty of them in a full circle this way.

title: Datalore
line: Then you say mark.

title: Datalore
line: On the nose.

title: Datalore
line: Which separates it from another full three hundred and sixty degree circle this way on a right angle to this one.

title: Datalore
line: So by ordering a heading so many degrees this way and so many this way, the ship can travel in any direction. All three dimensions.

title: Datalore
line: And the square of the hypotenuse of a right triangle

title: Datalore
line: Is equal to the sum of the square of the other two. Two something. Which I once heard, but never understood.

title: Datalore
line: All of which you will learn more about when the Captain has approved your being on the Bridge.

title: Datalore
line: Have I committed an offense?

title: Datalore
line: You will find that there are many rules on starships that must be learnt.

title: Datalore
line: You're very clever, Wesley. I now have duties to perform. Correct?

title: Datalore
line: Were you ever this anxious to please, Data?

title: Datalore
line: Never. I judge Lore to be superior in that desire.

title: Datalore
line: Because I was designed to be so human, my brother, I enjoy pleasing humans.

title: Datalore
line: My brother. That has a nice sound to it, Data.

title: Datalore
line: You consider it important to please humans?

title: Datalore
line: It's not important?

title: Datalore
line: There are many things of importance. Some more than others.

title: Datalore
line: Do you realize that Commander Riker's hypotenuse question tricked you into showing your knowledge was greater than you were indicating?

title: Datalore
line: He didn't seem that clever. I'll be more careful.

title: Datalore
line: You tend to underestimate humans, my brother. Praising young Wesley on the helm, for example

title: Datalore
line: A child!

title: Datalore
line: He has a child's body, but we have found him to be much more.

title: Datalore
line: Thank you for that information, too. You do care about how I perform. I pledge to be worthy of your teaching, my brother. Try not to be jealous of my abilities.

title: Datalore
line: What information are you requesting?

title: Datalore
line: Everything available on a Doctor Noonien Soong.

title: Datalore
line: Good old Often Wrong Soong. A joke, brother. Actually, he was a genius by human standards.

title: Datalore
line: But he had destroyed his own reputation by making what seemed wild promises about his positronic brain design, almost all of which failed.

title: Datalore
line: Promises he later proved to be true. Which made you and me possible, brother. Our beloved father. Will I soon have a uniform like that, brother?

title: Datalore
line: If you get one the way I did, Lore, it will mean four years at the Academy, another three as ensign, ten or twelve on varied space duty in the lieutenant grades.

title: Datalore
line: A system designed to compensate for limited human ability. And you, brother, are beginning to think as a human. You and I are completely different from them. Are you truly satisfied with the knowledge and memory of a few hundred human colonists? Suppose it could reflect thousands? Or millions? Or the knowledge of hundreds of millions of life forms of every kind?

title: Datalore
line: How?

title: Datalore
line: We will discuss that in time.

title: Datalore
line: And will we also discuss, Lore, which of us was constructed first?

title: Datalore
line: It would be foolish to underestimate you, brother. Yes, I lied when I said you were made first, but with good reason. Doctor Soong made me perfect in his first attempt. But he made me so completely human the colonists became envious of me.

title: Datalore
line: You lived with the colonists?

title: Datalore
line: Until they petitioned Soong to make a more comfortable, less perfect android. In other words, you, brother. Haven't you noticed how easily I handle human speech? I use their contractions. For example, I say can't or isn't, and you say cannot or is not. I say tomato, you say tomahto. I say potato, you say potahto. A very old joke. But then you also have trouble with their humor. Am I right?

title: Datalore
line: Quite true. I keep trying to be more human, and keep failing.

title: Datalore
line: Do you realize, brother, I can help you become more human?

title: Datalore
line: And do you realize, Lore, that I am obligated to report all of this to our ship's Captain?

title: Datalore
line: I assumed as much when I began studying you. May I use this to learn more of this vessel and its customs?

title: Datalore
line: Use it also to describe for the Captain the time you spent among the colonists. Including everything you know about what happened to them.

title: Datalore
line: I promise a report of great detail and accuracy.

title: Datalore
line: Thank you, Lore. I now have duties to perform. Unless of course, you need something more.

title: Datalore
line: I have more than I dreamed possible, brother.

title: Datalore
line: Captain's log, stardate 41242.5. Thanks to Lore's report, we now know what happened to the colonists. Beginning with a child's drawing, enhanced by Lore's description, our computer has constructed the image of a great crystalline entity which feeds on life, insatiably ravenous for the life force found in living forms, capable of stripping all life from an entire world.

title: Datalore
line: But how did Data escape that thing? Or Lore?

title: Datalore
line: Lore had been disassembled. He explained it as jealousy from the colonists. And Data wasn't yet alive at that time.

title: Datalore
line: Which explains why Data could be left outside in no danger from that creature. Whatever happened to the colonists, he would be found by the first Starfleet crew that responded to the signal he transmitted.

title: Datalore
line: By which Doctor Soong left proof behind that his experiment did work.

title: Datalore
line: Captain, how believable do you find that crystal thing?

title: Datalore
line: With so little of even our galaxy explored, I find it at least possible.

title: Datalore
line: Data, are you expecting Lore to come up here? He left your quarters some time ago.

title: Datalore
line: To go?

title: Datalore
line: My turbo-sensors say he went to deck four. Worf?

title: Datalore
line: Where he examined some micro-miniature work tools, and some fine grind quadratanium ?

title: Datalore
line: Which is used in our construction. That particular compound is no more suspicious, sir, than a human looking for an antiseptic or an ointment. Nevertheless, I should check it out.

title: Datalore
line: You're watching everything he does, Data? Is that the act of a brother?

title: Datalore
line: It's the act of a Starfleet officer obeying his Captain, Doctor.

title: Datalore
line: Captain? Speaking strictly as Security Chief, how much can you trust Data now?

title: Datalore
line: I trust him completely. But everyone should also realize that that was a necessary and legitimate security question.

title: Datalore
line: Thank you, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Lesson number one in becoming more human. You must observe all human customs.

title: Datalore
line: Champagne?

title: Datalore
line: An ancient ritual still practiced when they celebrate events of importance. My brother, I toast our discovery of each other. May it fill our lives with new meaning.

title: Datalore
line: I have some doubts about the value of human customs in this. My brother!

title: Datalore
line: And let us toast also Doctor Soong, who gave me the full richness of human needs and ambitions. A perfect match for my mind, my body.

title: Datalore
line: And let us toast also the great Crystal Entity with whom I learned to communicate. Before Doctor Soong disassembled me, I earned its gratitude by revealing the way to the colonists. Can you image its gratitude when I give it the life on this vessel?

title: Datalore
line: This is strange, sir. I show Commander Data transmitting on a subspace channel.

title: Datalore
line: I know Data's been doing considerable research on Doctor Soong's background. Let's be sure. Wesley, would you look in on Commander Data? Discreetly?

title: Datalore
line: Yes sir!

title: Datalore
line: Crystal Entity. Upon arriving here you can identify me as the machine named Data. End of message. Come in, please.

title: Datalore
line: Glad you are here, Wesley. Lore suddenly attacked me and I had to turn him off.

title: Datalore
line: Why did he do that, Data?

title: Datalore
line: He discovered we have been using sensors to follow what he does. I practiced his facial tic. Do I have it right?

title: Datalore
line: I'd suggest you forget imitating him. If you'd said we've been using the sensors, instead of we have, I might have suspected you were Lore.

title: Datalore
line: Yes. I do use language more formally than Lore. Please inform the Captain I will come up to the Bridge and report on this.

title: Datalore
line: Aye, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Wes, tell me again how Data said he immobilized Lore.

title: Datalore
line: He told me he just turned him off, Mom, er, Doctor.

title: Datalore
line: Question, Mister Data. Did you or did you not swear me to secrecy about your off switch?

title: Datalore
line: A change of mind, Doctor. If I cannot trust the bridge crew, whom can I?

title: Datalore
line: Captain, I'm picking up a bogey coming in on a five o'clock tangent.

title: Datalore
line: It's transmitting no ID signal, Captain.

title: Datalore
line: Set main viewer on that tangent.

title: Datalore
line: Shields up. Go to Yellow Alert. Transmit friendly greetings, all languages, all frequencies.

title: Datalore
line: I can't believe anything's overtaking us this fast.

title: Datalore
line: Beautiful, isn't it?

title: Datalore
line: I recognize it, sir. It's the crystal image Lore described.

title: Datalore
line: My God.

title: Datalore
line: Still no ID being transmitted, sir. Also no answer to our inquiries.

title: Datalore
line: Did you get a direct look at it?

title: Datalore
line: It's like a giant snow flake crystal, but much more complex. The entire electromagnetic spectrum seems to play about inside it, but I haven't the slightest idea what it is, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Thank you, Lieutenant. Data, is there anything else that Lore can tell us about it, it may be important. Can you control him enough to question him?

title: Datalore
line: I will have to examine him to know, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Captain, recommend that you do not let him roam the ship freely.

title: Datalore
line: Ensign.

title: Datalore
line: Wesley is only showing himself to be alert and responsible. Something to encourage. Come, you can watch everything I do.

title: Datalore
line: Not if I have a choice.

title: Datalore
line: That is enough, Ensign. When addressing a senior officer.

title: Datalore
line: I've guided his training, sir, I'm the one at fault. You will show the proper respect. I will accompany you down there to make certain of it. With your approval, of course, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Be careful of Lore. Good. He is still unconscious. Notice the same twitch, even though he is unconscious? Stay back. We may have problems if he senses someone else is near. Lore, I have a few questions to ask you.

title: Datalore
line: Lore, it is Data. He senses you. I cannot control him if you stay. Please! I will record everything he says.

title: Datalore
line: You will bring it to the Bridge, immediately.

title: Datalore
line: And you want to be as stupid as them, dear brother?

title: Datalore
line: Well, Number One?

title: Datalore
line: It was Lore, sir. Same facial twitches that we've seen all along. Lying unconscious on the floor exactly as Data had described. But then it suddenly became violent, apparently sensing that Wesley and I were present.

title: Datalore
line: Or is it Lore pretending to be Data and faking it all?

title: Datalore
line: I asked for Commander Riker's report, Acting Ensign Crusher. And since it now seems clear that you are unable to function within the limits of that appointment

title: Datalore
line: Captain!

title: Datalore
line: Deflector shields holding, sir.

title: Datalore
line: Bring photon torpedoes to ready. Main phasers to ready. Go to Red Alert, please.

title: Datalore
line: Weapons now ready, sir.

title: Datalore

However, should hostilities erupt, both the outpost and the starship will be out-gunned. It is felt that the Enterprise's presence in the area will be a vital show of force.

title: Angel One
line: Some show of force. The Enterprise could fly on autopilot, but with that virus knocking down our crew, we're going to be in sorry shape if things turn ugly.

line: You brought this upon yourself. You and the traitor. One does not need the technology of the Enterprise to follow Mistress Ariel sneaking out to warn her husband. Let her stand with him now. For tomorrow they will die together.

title: Angel One
line: You claim to be an advanced society, and yet you resort to executions in order to suppress those who don't share your views.

title: Angel One
line: That's very kind of you, but we're not going.

line: Haven't you been paying attention, Ramsey? You're scheduled to be executed tomorrow.

title: Angel One

title: Angel One
line: There's no time to debate the issues. You're going with us whether you choose to go or not.

title: Angel One
line: Excuse me, Commander, but removing any of these people against their will would be a violation of several Starfleet regulations, not the least of which would be the Prime Directive.

title: Angel One
line: I realize that, Mister Data. I'd rather face a court martial than live with the guilt of leaving these people to their deaths. Commander Riker to Enterprise.

title: Angel One
line: This is the Enterprise. Crusher here.

line: They might be facing the same thing up here. Until I have a better idea of what I'm dealing with, no one can beam up. I'm sorry, Will, but you must wait.

title: Angel One

title: Angel One
line: We have determined that the heretical teachings of Ramsey and his followers are inconsistent with harmonious life on Angel One. Our patient efforts to silence revolutionary voices have failed. Therefore we are left with none but the most final alternative.

title: Angel One
line: As you can see, we are not without compassion. Your deaths will be swift and painless.

title: Angel One
line: Mistress Beata, before we see living examples of your compassion, may I speak?

title: Angel One
line: Is this a plea for leniency?

title: Angel One
line: Nothing of the sort. As the governing body of Angel One, you're entitled to execute your laws or your citizens as you see fit.

title: Angel One

title: Angel One
line: When you spoke of the prisoners, you used the term revolutionary. Indeed, death has been known to stop revolutions. But I suspect it's not a revolution that Angel One is hoping to stop. It's evolution. Mister Ramsey and the Odin survivors did not initiate the waves of dissent that are rippling through your planet. Their presence here merely reinforced the change in attitudes between men and women that was already well under way. They became symbols around whom others who shared their views could gather. You may eliminate the symbols, but that does not mean death to the issues which those symbols represent. No power in the universe can hope to stop the force of evolution. Be warned. The execution of Mister Ramsey and his followers may elevate them to the status of martyrs. Martyrs cannot be silenced.

title: Angel One

title: Angel One
line: Excellent, Doctor. We still have seventeen minutes left. I will inform the away team immediately. Enterprise to Riker.

title: Angel One

title: Angel One

title: Angel One
line: After careful consideration, this legislature has voted to stay the execution of the prisoners. Their children will be returned to them immediately. Do not rejoice prematurely. Ramsey and his followers are to be exiled to a distant and unpopulated region. Life will be difficult there with little time for revolutionary or evolutionary upheaval. As some have observed, we may be able to stop evolution, but perhaps we can reduce it to a slow crawl. For a man, you can be very clever, Commander Riker.

line: Riker to Enterprise. Belay my previous order, Mister Data. There will now be only three to beam up. Energize.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Number One, prepare your away team.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Right away. Data, Yar.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Doctor Crusher, have you been monitoring all this?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes. I'll meet the away team in transporter room four.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Let's go. The life signs are weak.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What is this?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No idea. We'll go around, just to be on the safe side.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Let's try the other way.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Enterprise, this is Riker. We've got a problem.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What kind of problem, Number One?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I'm not sure yet. There appears to be some kind of a slick blocking our path. Will keep you apprised.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Maintain an open frequency.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Aye, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Analysis, Mister Data.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Inconclusive, sir. I cannot tell you what it is, but I can tell you what it is not.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Explain.

title: Skin of Evil
line: There is no evidence of neural or circulatory systems. No internal organs. Cellular structure unknown. It does not have any proteins which are known to us.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It's narrower over here. We can get over it.

title: Skin of Evil
line: How is it moving, Data?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I do not know, sir. It does not appear to have a skeletal framework or musculature.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then what's causing it to move?

title: Skin of Evil
line: It appears to be following us, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No sign of intelligence, no brain as we know it, yet evidence of thought, Mister Data?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Insufficient information, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Is it a life form, Data?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Again, insufficient information, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Theorize.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It is possible.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Very good, tin man.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What is it, Number One? What are you seeing?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Trouble.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Captain's log, supplemental. While on a mission to rescue survivors from an unexplained shuttle crash, the away team has encountered a strange creature which seems able to assume different forms, including one which resembles humanoid.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Easy, Number One. Let's find out what it is we're dealing with.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Agreed, Captain.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Number One, I don't believe that the location of the crash and the proximity of the creature is a coincidence.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I am Commander William Riker of the USS Enterprise.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I am Armus. Why are you here?

title: Skin of Evil
line: We mean you no harm. We have injured crewmen in the shuttlecraft. We need to get to them. May we pass?

title: Skin of Evil
line: You haven't given me a good enough reason.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Preserving life, all life, is very important to us.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Why?

title: Skin of Evil
line: We believe everything in the universe has a right to exist.

title: Skin of Evil
line: An interesting notion which I do not share. You may now leave, if you wish.

title: Skin of Evil
line: We're not going without our shuttle crew.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I warn you.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Enough! We have people who need attention. We won't hurt you, but we must help them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Number One!

title: Skin of Evil
line: The creature attacked us. Lieutenant Yar is down.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It seems to feed on our phaser energy.

title: Skin of Evil
line: We had no effect on it.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What's Lieutenant Yar's condition? Doctor Crusher, report!

title: Skin of Evil
line: She's dead.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Transporter room, get them up, now.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I need her in Sickbay now.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Go to Yellow Alert, Lieutenant Worf. I'll be in Sickbay.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Aye, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Status, Doctor?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Unchanged.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Can you bring her back?

title: Skin of Evil
line: We'll see. Neural stimulator.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Neural stimulator locked in.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Interlock current feeds. Set sensitivity factor to four point four.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Affirmative.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Monitoring two point three, one point eight.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You did it.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. I've got her on full support. There is no independent brain function.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Current feeds operating.

title: Skin of Evil
line: She's not responding, Doctor. Her synaptic network is breaking down.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Inject norep.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Neurons are beginning to depolarize.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Let's go for direct reticular stimulation.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Direct?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Do it! Increase to seventy microvolts.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Eighty five microvolts. Again. Ninety. Again. Again. She's gone.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Gone?

title: Skin of Evil
line: There was too much synaptic damage. That thing just sucked the life right out of her. There's nothing I can do.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Your friends have deserted you. They're not coming back.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You're wrong.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I killed one of them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes. I know.

title: Skin of Evil
line: How could you be in there and know that?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I felt her die.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Do you want to know why I killed her?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Your answer would be meaningless. That act had no reason.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Exactly. It had no meaning. I did it because I wanted to. It amused me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. You thought it would amuse you, but it didn't. You felt no satisfaction.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. It was too easy.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You wanted her to suffer. You have a great need.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I need nothing.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Liar. End this. Let us go.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Not yet.

title: Skin of Evil
line: They won't give you what you want.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And what is that?

title: Skin of Evil
line: To break their spirit.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Oh, is that what I want? If breaking their spirit will amuse me, then that's what I will have.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Never.

title: Skin of Evil
line: She didn't do anything. Her phaser was lowered.

title: Skin of Evil
line: She only wanted to get to Troi and Lieutenant Prieto.

title: Skin of Evil
line: There was nothing provocative about what she did.

title: Skin of Evil
line: She was killed in a brutal, senseless act.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Lieutenant Yar's death is very painful for all of us. We will have to deal with it as best we can for now. Until the shuttle crew is safely beamed aboard this ship, our feelings will have to wait. Is that understood? Lieutenant Worf, you are now Acting Chief of Security.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I will do my best, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Doctor, what is the state of the shuttle crew?

title: Skin of Evil
line: We're still receiving faint life signs, but the sensor readings are fluctuating. They may not be accurate.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Armus is capable of creating undefined forcefields. In effect, we are powerless to communicate or use the transporter unless it allows it.

title: Skin of Evil
line: A creature against whom we seem to have no defense. Number One?

title: Skin of Evil
line: It's down on that planet waiting for us to come back. It killed Tasha and it could have killed us, but it didn't. Deanna and Ben are alive for a reason, and it knows we're not going anywhere as long as they're still alive.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Are you saying it's attack on Yar was not arbitrary but part of some tactic?

title: Skin of Evil
line: The only way to find out is to go back down.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Commander, I may be able to see something in the creature which might be helpful.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Agreed. Prepare your away team, Number One.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Lieutenant Worf?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I will remain on the ship. The object here is not to engage the creature in battle. The goal is the safe return of Counselor Troi and Lieutenant Prieto. I can best accomplish this at the Tactical Station.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Very good. Number One?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Enterprise.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Number One.

title: Skin of Evil
line: We're approaching the shuttlecraft. The creature is covering it.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I lied to you. They came back.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Let me talk with them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Why? Does the thought of my having contact with them make you uneasy?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. Not being able to contact you, not knowing if you are alive, makes them uneasy. Can't you feel how worried they are?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes. Yes, they are worried.

title: Skin of Evil
line: They care for you. You must be very special.

title: Skin of Evil
line: We are members of a community. We all care for one another.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Equally?

title: Skin of Evil
line: You were really surprised they came back.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Why? Because the others did not?

title: Skin of Evil
line: What others?

title: Skin of Evil
line: You can't hide the emptiness from me. The others. The ones who hurt you. Who left you alone, rejected. The ones who make you so angry.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What do you know of them?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Only what you tell me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I will tell you nothing.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Not now. But soon.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Captain, look at this. The force of the energy field around the shuttlecraft decreased for a few moments when the creature was draped over it.

title: Skin of Evil
line: But not low enough to beam them out.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Almost.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It's approaching the away team now, and the energy field over the shuttlecraft is back to full intensity.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Chart it. I want to see if there's a pattern.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Aye, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: She said you'd be back.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then she is alive.

title: Skin of Evil
line: For now. Why have you returned?

title: Skin of Evil
line: We have no choice. We're here to negotiate for our team. What do you want?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Maybe I want nothing.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then you would have killed all of us.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I still might.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What do you want? Tell me. Maybe we can reach an accommodation.

title: Skin of Evil
line: If I tell you, will you give it to me?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I might. It depends.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I am a doctor. I need to treat our injured friends.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Say please.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Please.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You ask nicely. I will allow it. Wait! I've changed my mind. Talk to her from here.

title: Skin of Evil
line: How? Troi, can you hear me?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Deanna, are you all right?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Beverly?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I can hear you.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Are you all right?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes.

title: Skin of Evil
line: We've encountered some difficulty.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I know.

title: Skin of Evil
line: She needs our help.

title: Skin of Evil
line: So what.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Our friends are suffering only a few meters away, yet you block our path. Why?

title: Skin of Evil
line: You are all ungrateful.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What is he made of?

title: Skin of Evil
line: It did not register on the tricorder.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It? Does that mean I am not alive?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. Clearly you are some kind of intelligent form.

title: Skin of Evil
line: But you said I did not register on your instrument. Perhaps your instruments are useless.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Don't help him.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Data.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Half meter to the right, Geordi.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Aren't you going to lead him to his sight again, robot?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. You will just move it again, and I will not help you hurt him.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then give it to him. I will find something else to amuse me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You said they wouldn't amuse me. You were right.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And the emptiness remains. You sound so alone.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I am alone.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Abandoned. Who deserted you?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Creatures whose beauty now dazzles all who see them. They would not exist without me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You were together?

title: Skin of Evil
line: They perfected a means of bringing to the surface all that was evil and negative within. Erupting, spreading, connecting. In time it formed second skin, dank and vile.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes.

title: Skin of Evil
line: They discarded you and left.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And here I am.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You have my pity.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Your pity? Save that for yourself.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Help! Data, something's got me!

title: Skin of Evil
line: Touch him and he dies.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No! No, don't!

title: Skin of Evil
line: Enterprise?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Armus has enveloped Commander Riker.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I'm beaming you up.

title: Skin of Evil
line: If any of you leave now, he dies.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And so do the survivors of the crash.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Captain's log, supplemental. There is grave danger to the crew on Vagra Two. My first officer is missing, attacked by this entity known as Armus.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Captain, perhaps you should look at this. We have the chart of the energy field surrounding the shuttle.

title: Skin of Evil
line: There are a great deal of fluctuations.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes, but there is a pattern. Here is when it killed Lieutenant Yar, and here is when it absorbed Commander Riker.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And here, here, where the energy is lowest?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Both times it had enveloped the shuttle.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It has something to do with Counselor Troi. Somehow when it's dealing with her, the energy field is affected. I want to talk to her. I'm going to beam down. Lieutenant Worf, you have the conn.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Imzadi! No! Please, stop hurting him!

title: Skin of Evil
line: He resists. If he would give himself over, the pain would diminish. He struggles. You should feel his strength.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I can.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Should I let him go?

title: Skin of Evil
line: You only ask to torment me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Perhaps.

title: Skin of Evil
line: How should I answer? What can I offer except myself?

title: Skin of Evil
line: And would you give yourself for him? Would you give that much?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes. Without hesitation.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Just for him?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No, not just for him. I would do the same for any of the others. Armus, you have me. Let them go.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Perhaps. Ah, another has arrived.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You are the one in charge?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Is Commander Riker alive?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Answer, Tin Man.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I would guess that death is no longer sufficient entertainment to alleviate its boredom. Therefore, Commander Riker is alive.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Maybe. Don't you want to ask me what I want?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Not even to protect your own existence?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I want to see my people in the shuttle.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Entertain me. Then I will do it myself. You, Tin Man.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Now tell me, how would you feel if you were the instrument of death for your leader?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Don't struggle, Data.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I have no control over what you do with the phaser. Therefore, I would not be the instrument of his death.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Perhaps killing the Doctor would engender more feeling?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No, the control is still yours.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And what about you, Doctor? Are you ready to die? Tell me you are not afraid.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I am afraid.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Beg me to spare you.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No.

title: Skin of Evil
line: One of you is going to die, and you, Doctor, get to choose. You don't like that, do you?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then I choose myself.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. You are going to live. One of them dies.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Maybe this one. Though I would not call it death, since he is only a device. Tell me, Tin Man, how does it feel to face your own extinction.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Curious. You are capable of great sadism and cruelty. Interesting. No redeeming qualities.

title: Skin of Evil
line: So what do you think?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I think you should be destroyed.

title: Skin of Evil
line: A moral judgment from a machine.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Data. Armus, we're finished dealing with you.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I have your man in here, and the others in the shuttle.

title: Skin of Evil
line: It doesn't matter. We will no longer be a source of amusement.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I can kill them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes. You can. But only I can command them. They follow my orders.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Have them amuse me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Only if you let me see my people on the shuttle first. I must see them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Not possible.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then our business with you is concluded.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And you claim you care about your comrades.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I care. Which is why I must see them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You want to see your people? Then, here. Look at this one.

title: Skin of Evil
line: He's alive. Don't move.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Is he all right?

title: Skin of Evil
line: All signs show normal.

title: Skin of Evil
line: So much frustration. It had to get rid of me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Now, let me see the others.

title: Skin of Evil
line: No.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I will not allow my people to entertain you until you do.

title: Skin of Evil
line: They are incapable of entertaining me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I want the four of you out of here. Enterprise, beam up the away team immediately.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Aye, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: They're no longer involved. This is between you and me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: They may leave.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Now.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I want to leave this place.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You want me to give you transportation?

title: Skin of Evil
line: For which I will trade you lives.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I must see my people in the shuttle.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Will you give me what I want?

title: Skin of Evil
line: I have the means. But first I must see my people.

title: Skin of Evil
line: If you must.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Troi, are you all right?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes, but Ben is not.

title: Skin of Evil
line: He's alive.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Were you able to help Tasha?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No. Troi. Troi, we must talk. I believe it's possible to outmaneuver this creature, and beam you and Ben back up to the ship. We've been monitoring the energy field that surrounds the shuttle. When the creature is here, the field weakens. Do you know why?

title: Skin of Evil
line: The creature is filled with rage. Undirected, unfocused rage. When he confronts it, his guard goes down because he's feeling it instead of suppressing it. Acknowledging his needs makes him vulnerable.

title: Skin of Evil
line: What caused the rage?

title: Skin of Evil
line: He was left here. Abandoned.

title: Skin of Evil
line: The forcefield will have to drop below two point seven before we can beam them up.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Satisfied?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Then can we leave?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Where do you want to go? Do you want to try to find those who left you here?

title: Skin of Evil
line: She told you about them.

title: Skin of Evil
line: How long have you been here?

title: Skin of Evil
line: Since they left. A very long time.

title: Skin of Evil
line: A long time to be alone.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Save your compassion. It's revolting. You offer it like a prize when in fact it's an insult.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Because you feel unworthy.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You overrate your gift. You humans are puny, weak.

title: Skin of Evil
line: But our spirit, it is indomitable.

title: Skin of Evil
line: And still you die from a flake of my power.

title: Skin of Evil
line: A great poet once said, 'all spirits are enslaved that serve things evil'.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You do not understand. I do not serve things evil. I am evil.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Oh, no, you are not.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I am a skin of evil left here by a race of Titans who believed if they rid themselves of me, they would free the bonds of destructiveness.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes. So here you are. Feeding on your own loneliness. Consumed by your own pain. Believing your own lies.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Set the computer. When the energy level reaches two point six point two zero five, automatically beam up Troi and Prieto. We'll do a parallel transport on the Captain.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Yes, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: You say you are true evil? Shall I tell you what true evil is? It is to submit to you. It is when we surrender our freedom, our dignity, instead of defying you.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I will kill you, and those in there.

title: Skin of Evil
line: But you will still be here. In this place. For ever. Alone. Immortal.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Stand by for parallel transport.

title: Skin of Evil
line: The energy level has dropped to two point six point three.

title: Skin of Evil
line: That's your real fear. Never to die. Never again to be united with those who left you here.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Energy field is two point six. Computer beginning transport.

title: Skin of Evil
line: I'm not taking you anywhere.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Captain's log, stardate 41602.1. The shuttlecraft has been destroyed to prevent any possibility of Armus leaving the planet. Vagra Two will be declared off limits. But the damage has been done. One of the saddest duties I've ever had to perform is now ahead of me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: We are here together to honor our friend and comrade, Lieutenant Natasha Yar. Coming to terms with the loss of a colleague is perhaps the most difficult tasks we must face in the work we have chosen to pursue. We will all find time to grieve for her in the days that are ahead, but for now she has asked that we celebrate her life with this.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Hello, my friends. You are here now watching this image of me because I have died. It probably happened while I was on duty, and quickly, which is what I expected. Never forget I died doing exactly what I chose to do. What I want you to know is how much I loved my life, and those of you who shared it with me. You are my family. You all know where I came from and what my life was like before. But Starfleet took that frightened, angry young girl and tempered her. I have been blessed with your friendship and your love. Will Riker, you are the best. You trusted me, you encouraged me, and most of all you made me laugh. Deanna, you are capable of so much love. You taught me without ever having to say a word. I realized I could be feminine without losing anything. Ah, Worf. We are so much alike, you and I. Both warriors, orphans who found ourselves this family. I hope I met death with my eyes wide open. Beverly. Your fierce devotion comes from within. It can't be diminished. From you, I have learned to strive for excellence, no matter what the personal cost. Wesley, I'm sorry I won't be able to see you grow into the exceptional man you'll be. But your kindness and innocence are ageless. Geordi, in those moments I felt the most despair, you took my hand and helped me to see things differently. You taught me to look beyond the moment. My friend Data. You see things with the wonder of a child, and that makes you more human than any of us. Captain Jean-Luc Picard. I wish I could say you've been like a father to me, but I've never had one, so I don't know what it feels like. But if there was someone in this universe I could choose to be like, someone who I would want to make proud of me, it's you. You who have the heart of an explorer and the soul of a poet. So, you'll understand when I say, death is that state in which one exists only in the memory of others. Which is why it is not an end. No goodbyes. Just good memories. Hailing frequencies closed, sir.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Au revoir, Natasha. The gathering is concluded.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Sir, the purpose of this gathering confuses me.

title: Skin of Evil
line: Oh? How so?

title: Skin of Evil
line: My thoughts are not for Tasha, but for myself. I keep thinking how empty it will feel without her presence. Did I miss the point?

title: Skin of Evil
line: No, you didn't, Data. You got it.

title: Symbiosis
line: All hands, this is the Captain. As you may know, the sun in the Delos system is undergoing large-scale magnetic field changes, producing violent, gigantic flares. Now, we shall be studying this star at close range. Even though we shall be running with full deflectors, the closeness of this event and its severity are going to create problems.

title: Symbiosis
line: Intense magnetic fields have a disruptive effect on electrical systems. Therefore we can expect communications interruptions, as well as potential temporary loss of other systems. As a precaution, we are now going to Yellow Alert. Stay sharp, everyone.

title: Symbiosis
line: Attention all decks. Yellow Alert.

title: Symbiosis
line: Engineering, this is Lieutenant Commander Data. Bring all systems online and direct full power to the shields.

title: Symbiosis
line: All sections secure, sir.

title: Symbiosis
line: Lieutenant La Forge?

title: Symbiosis
line: Course is set, Captain.

title: Symbiosis
line: Half impulse.

title: Symbiosis
line: Aye, sir, one half impulse.
