title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yeah. It would be difficult for me to be leaving all the time. I'd miss my friends, the people I love. I guess leaving's gotten easy for you.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I seem to have a way of using up a place.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I wasn't talking about a place.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I know. I know what you were talking about.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: It's ready. You should be able to install this in roughly five minutes.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Like you said, Geordi, what's the rush? I have some friends around here. I think it's time to make a stand.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Mister Okona.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Captain, I've decided not to leave.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Oh.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Don't worry, I'm not staying either.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Just what are your plans, Mister Okona?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I've decided to surrender myself.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: To which one?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: There's really only one option.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Viewer on. Gentlemen, communicating like this is very distracting. I suggest that we beam you up to the Enterprise and we resolve this face to face.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Excellent.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Agreed.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Leave your weapons behind. Let's keep this civilized.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Number One, you have the Bridge. Counselor Troi, would you accompany me to deck fourteen conference room. Worf, see to our guests.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: They have no weapons.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: This way.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Okona, you are without shame.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: For once I agree with Debin. You are without shame. I trusted you. My son treated you like a brother. And then to steal from us. I want him now.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No, he's coming with me. Captain, my complaint was registered first.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Now please, please, be calm. Lieutenant, thank you.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Everyone is talking about me, and no one's talking to me. You all believe that I stole the jewel, and that it was I who fathered the child.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: You dare call my daughter a liar?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: And now I'm offered these two choices, and given these two options, condemnation as a thief or marriage to the beautiful Yanar. I will take the more pleasant sentence. I will take Yanar as my wife.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No! You can't!

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: My son is right. You can't escape that way.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: That's not what I mean.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: It's not up to you, or to Okona. I've been dishonored. I will decide.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Wait. Since all of you believe Okona is the father of this child, then so be it. I'll marry you.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No! You can't.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yes, I can.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Okona is still a thief.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No, he's not. Nothing has been stolen. The Jewel of Thesia has been taken into custody by its rightful heir. Me. I was to give it to Yanar as our pledge of marriage.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Marriage?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yanar is carrying my child.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: You said it was Okona's.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: If I'd told you it was Benzan you would have gone to war with his father. So I let you believe it was Okona.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: See how a man gets a reputation?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: If I had told you I was giving the Jewel to Debin's daughter, you'd have disowned me.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Now we're hearing some truth.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: So you let me chase Okona when you knew he was innocent.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yes, because I didn't believe for one moment that you could catch him.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Well, said. He never would have.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: And once Yanar accepted the Jewel the marriage would have been made.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Well, I never got it.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Then Okona does have the jewel.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I never had the chance to deliver it.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Anyway it's too late. I won't marry Benzan.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Then you'll marry Okona.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I won't marry anyone!

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I have reinstated the same program.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Along with some new jokes, I hope.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Program complete. Enter when ready.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Comic, continue.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: More freebies, huh? No cover, no minimum, just Comic, continue? Tell me, Data, what happened?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I told a joke.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: And?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No one laughed.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No one? Nobody in the whole room?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I was the whole room.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: She said I spoiled the joke.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Actually, killed would have been a better word.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: You know, Data, I think I know what your problem is. You should always try out new material on an audience.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: You know, he could be right. Perhaps an audience is what you need.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Computer. Program an audience appropriate to this venue.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yanar. You're angry at the embarrassment of all this, and maybe the timing and the approach is not the most romantic, but I know you love Benzan and I don't want to see you throw away that feeling just because your parents have been quarreling for years and don't know how to behave properly. I've carried your messages back and forth for almost six months. I've smuggled each of you into the other's homeland. You feel for him the same way he feels for you.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I do love you. It is your child. Our child.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Marry me.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yes.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: We'll find a new planet to live on.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: You'll live on Straleb.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No, no, no, no no. You'll live on Atlec.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I will not have this man raising my grandson.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: The rest of this is an issue, gentlemen, to be settled between yourselves. Now if you will excuse us, we have business.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Thank you, Captain.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Your grandson?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: My grandson.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Thank you. Thank you. Thanks for coming, folks. We got a great show for you tonight. I'm so excited this evening. Tonight I have for you the funny man of the stars, the android of antics, that Lieutenant Commander of mirth. Please give him a nice welcome, ladies and gentlemen, none other than. He's just the best. Data!

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Good evening ladies and germs. I come from a town so small, we had a fraction for a zip code.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: You made a living doing this?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Yes, I did.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: It was so small in fact we didn't have a godfather of crime, we had a nephew. I was so ugly as a child they hung a pork chop around my neck so the dog would play with me. And then there was the human cannonball who was hired and fired in the same night. Audience program off. Discontinue Comic.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: It was a holodeck audience. They were programmed to laugh at everything. Perhaps I should reprogram the audience to display a more accurate response.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Data, let me give you one. Being able to make people laugh, or being able to laugh, is not the end all and be all of being human.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: No, but there is nothing more uniquely human.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Hold your speed, Captain Okona. Disengage.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Separated.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: I'm under my own power now. Thank you, Enterprise. Thank you, Captain Picard.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Goodbye, Captain Okona.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Bye, Captain Okona. Say goodbye, Data.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Goodbye, Data.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Was that funny? Accessing. Ah. Burns and Allen, Roxy Theater, New York City, 1932. It still works. Then there was the one about the girl in the nudist colony that nothing looked good on?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: We're ready to get underway, sir.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Take my Worf. Please.

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Warp speed, sir?

title: The Outrageous Okona
line: Please.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Any response from Gravesworld, Mister Worf?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Nothing sir. Not since their initial communication.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: They send out a plea for help, then they cut off transmission so they can't tell if there's any help on the way. Doesn't make much sense, does it?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Ensign, what's our ETA at the planet?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Thirty six minutes to orbit, sir.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Starfleet Command considers Graves' work on molecular cybernetics is reaching a critical stage. They consider this a priority one action.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: A man is ill, Captain. Treating him is my priority one, regardless of who he is.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Did Data say why he wants to see us?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He said something about his new image. I tell you, he's been acting kind of strange lately.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: How so?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Well, if I didn't know better, I'd say he was showing signs of insecurity.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes, but you do know better. Androids don't feel such things.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I don't know. Sometimes I think he's becoming more human than any of us realize.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Come in.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Data?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Geordi? Is Counselor Troi with you?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes, I'm here, Data. Geordi said you wanted to see us.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Indeed. Or, stated more correctly, I wanted you to see me.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Can we come in?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Please.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Did you damage your face, Data?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: It is a beard, Geordi. A fine, full, dignified beard. One which commands respect and projects thoughtfulness and dignity. Well? Opinions?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: It's er, very different.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: When I stroke the beard thusly, do I not appear more intellectual?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I'm sorry, I have to go now. Goodbye.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Why was she laughing?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: We are receiving a transmission from Gravesworld, sir. It's unfocused. Not directed specifically at us.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: On viewer, Mister Worf.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: If anyone can hear me, please send a doctor. Things are getting worse.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Try and raise her, Mister Crusher. Tell them we're only minutes away.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: It's no good, sir. I don't believe they're receiving us.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Our records show that she and Graves are the only ones living on the planet, Captain.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Then what scared her?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Captain, I am picking up another signal, but it is not from the planet.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: On screen, Mister Worf.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: The signal is very weak, sir. Audio only.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Pipe it through.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Mayday! Mayday! This is the USS questing emergency assistance. The outer hull is breached and environmental systems compromised. Need assistance.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Captain, I show the Constantinople in that general vicinity. She's a transport ship, used to ferry settlers. I'm showing two thousand and twelve colonists aboard.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Outer hull breach. She must have had an internal explosion.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: If that's the case, they'll all be prone to severe hypoxia. Their lives are at risk. We've got to help them.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: And what about Graves?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He's one man.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Suggestion, Captain. Why don't we execute a long range transport of an away team to assist Doctor Graves at earliest possible moment. We'd come out of warp just long enough to energize the beam.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: A touch and go down warping? Mister Crusher, prepare to make it so.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Aye sir.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Engineering, Mister La Forge. We're going to execute a near warp

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Transport. This may be a little tricky. I would like you to handle it.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes, Captain.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I'm on my way.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Assemble an away team, Number One. Include whoever the Doctor requires to assist.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Excuse me sir, but there may be hundreds on the Constantinople that require emergency attention. I should be there to supervise.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: All right, who will replace you?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Lieutenant Selar. She has my complete confidence.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Worf, let's go.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Phaser on stun, Mister Worf. We don't know what's going on down there. There's no need to take any chances.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Agreed, sir.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Now remember, this is a near warp transport, so the effects may be a little unusual.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: What do you mean?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You'll see, Counselor. Energize.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Now wait a minute. I don't understand

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You do now.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: This might sound crazy, but for a moment I thought I was stuck in that wall.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: For a moment, you were.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Data to Enterprise.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I read you, Commander. Go ahead.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: We are inside Graves' home.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: All is quiet so far. Of course, no one knew we were coming.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Use caution, but protect Graves' health

title: The Schizoid Man
line: At all costs.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Understood, sir. I suggest we look around to see if anybody is home.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: No need, Commander.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You heard me. Thank God. I'm Kareen Brianon, Doctor Graves' assistant.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: We're from a ship called the Enterprise. We monitored your distress call but then you never acknowledged our response.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I'm sorry, I couldn't take the chance.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Chance? What chance?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: The chance that I might find out someone was coming. Kareen knew full well that I would not be pleased, to put it mildly.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I had no choice. I refuse to stand by and watch you deteriorate.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: What symptoms have you noticed?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He has pain, shortness of breath, irritability.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Ridiculous! I'm as healthy as a Rigelian ox!

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He's not himself, believe me. His temper is completely out of control.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Nonsense!

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Ira!

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I am a doctor. Lieutenant Selar.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: No offense, but I don't want you touching me in any way. It's no secret that I don't like people much, and I like doctors even less.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: That's funny, I thought most doctors were people.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Then you're wrong. Ask any patient. Although I will admit, for a doctor you're not a bad looking woman. Well, well, well, what have we got here? Another lovely specimen of womanhood.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I thought you didn't like people.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Women aren't people. They're women.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I'm Deanna Troi. It's an honor to meet you, Doctor Graves.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes, of course it is. This is one of the truly great moments of your life.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Excuse me, sir. Are you a Romulan?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Hardly.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He's a Klingon, Kareen. Kareen has lived here since her father died when she was very young. Her only knowledge of unhuman races comes from me. Klingons and Romulans don't look much alike, Kareen, even though they act much alike.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Must I stand here and be insulted?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: No insult intended, Mister Klingon. You see, Doctor, there's nothing wrong with my hearing. My, my, my, my.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Lieutenant Commander Data

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Shhh! Absolutely no esthetic value whatsoever. Looks like Soong's work.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Quite correct, sir! Did you know Doctor Soong?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Know him?! I taught him everything he knows. You could say that I was the father of his work. Which kind of makes me your grandfather, doesn't it sonny? Damn doctors! Always sneaking up on one. Attacking from the rear. Go on, gorgeous. Spit it out. Whatever the hell it is, I can take it.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I've checked twice to make certain. You have Darnay's disease. I'm sorry, Doctor Graves. It's in it's final stage.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Can't you do something for him?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: In all cases, Darnay's is terminal.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Captain's log, Stardate 42437.7. We've successfully repaired the stricken liner, Constantinople. Forty six of her people suffered injuries, mostly minor. They have been treated and supplied with the proper medicines. Our task complete, we are heading back to Gravesworld with great dispatch.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I have noticed, Doctor

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Call me Grandpa. Seems more touching in my final hours.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I have noticed, Grandpa, that you keep repeating the same notes of a musical phrase I am unfamiliar with.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: It's an ancient little tune called 'If I Only Had A Heart.' A plaintive lament sung by a mechanical man who longs to be human. It's his only wish.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: What happens to this man?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He finds out he's human after all. Always was. Just worried so much, he never realized it.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: A happy ending. The mechanical man gets his wish.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Stories often have happy endings. It's life that throws you for a loop. It must be so hard for you, to be so close to being human and yet never really knowing what it's like to know pain.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: But pain is unpleasant, is it not?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Pain. Lust. Envy. Pleasure. Desire. Do you know what desire is, Data?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Desire? To long for, to crave, a wish, a request, a

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Do you know what desire is?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: No. I do not suppose I will ever really know.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I feel pity for you. Your existence must be a kind of walking purgatory. Neither dead nor alive. Never really feeling anything. Just existing. Just existing. Listen to me. A dying man takes the time to mourn a man who will never know death. Funny, isn't it?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Funny. I have had great difficulty determining what funny is.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I've had the same difficulty most of my life. We're much alike.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I'd say he has a week, but that's only an estimate. We do know that the disease attacks the brain and nervous system. We can expect more of the erratic behavior of the kind you've been noticing.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: His feelings towards you are very warm. He's attracted to you in many ways.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Attracted? I know I've felt certain feelings from him. And for him. Had I been older, perhaps we could've been. That's not the way it worked out. And now it's like he's afraid to face me. The only one he talks to is your friend, Data.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You mentioned your impending death, Grandpa. May I say you face it with remarkable courage and stoicism.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: That is because I am an incredible man, possessing an iron will and nerves of steel. Two traits that helped me become the genius I am today as well as the lady killer I was in days gone by.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You condone homicide, sir?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: It's an expression, Data. It means I was once as beautiful as I am smart.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Really, Grandpa?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: No, not really. But what the hell. I'm dying. I can remember my life any way I want. And I'll let you into a little secret, Sonny. I don't really believe I will be dying.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: But the Doctor

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Oh, I'll die, but I won't really be dead. You see, I believe I've learned to transfer the wealth of my knowledge into a computer. Before I die, I plan to transfer my great intelligence into this machine, thus cheating the Grim Reaper of his greatest prize. But what would you know of death? It is a subject forever alien to you.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: That is not necessarily true, Grandpa. I do have an off button, if you will. Its activation robs me of my consciousness, therefore rendering me dead for all intents and purposes. It is not something I enjoy contemplating.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I can understand that. Just where would Soong position such a device? Don't tell me, let me guess.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Captain to away team. We're standing by.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I do not wish to interrupt Data and the Doctor. They seem to have developed a genuine rapport. But the Enterprise has reached it's orbit and I'd like to transport Graves to the ship as soon as possible.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: That will not be necessary, Doctor. He is gone.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Gone?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: It happened just a few moments ago, in my arms. Ira Graves is dead.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Captain's log, supplemental. I leave Gravesworld with an empty feeling and the knowledge that our mission was unsuccessful. Whatever scientific secrets Ira Graves was about to unlock have been lost forever. Our immediate priority is to reach the nearest starbase so that Graves' assistant can get on with her life.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Why didn't you contact Doctor Selar when you saw that he was beginning to go?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: To do so would have been pointless. All things must pass. May I go now, sir?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes, of course.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: We will try to honor him in the manner in which he specified, will we not, sir?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I said we would, Data.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I am glad, sir. It was his dying wish.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Hello Data. It's good to see you again. The stars are so beautiful from space. Yet they seem

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You always did love the sky. A stargazer. That is what you are.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Did Ira tell you that? I guess he's right. I used to spend hours just lying on a hill, looking up.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Ira never told you how beautiful you were to him. He never told you that, did he? He could not tell you, do you understand?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes. I understand.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He wanted to. Every waking moment. And he wanted you to know that. You were everything to him.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: He was a fine man. A man of rare gifts. and great accomplishments. He will be sorely missed. Does anyone else have anything to say?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I believe I have a few words to say, sir. Just look at that face. The face of a thinker. A warrior. A man for all seasons. Yes, Ira Graves was all that and more. But he was not perfect. Perhaps his greatest fault was that he was too selfless. He cared too much for his fellow man, with nary a thought for himself. A man of limitless accomplishments, and unbridled modesty. I can safely say that to know him was to love him. And to love him was to know him. Those who knew him, loved him, while those who did not know him, loved him from afar.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Data.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I'm almost finished, sir.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: You are finished, Data.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: We now commit the body of Ira Graves to the timeless depths of space.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I am sorry, sir. Perhaps it was my admiration for Grandpa that got the best of me.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Grandpa?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: That is the way I think of him, sir. My only living relative, no longer living.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Data.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I was only trying to carry out his wishes. I just wanted to keep my promise to him.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: I know that, Data. Look, I realize you've been studying the human equation with great alacrity, but perhaps you've been working at it too much. Don't try so hard to be human. Just be yourself. All right?

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Yes, sir. I will work on staying within myself.

title: The Schizoid Man
line: Grand. You're dismissed, Mister Data.
