line: No. We're a rescue party. We picked up your colony's distress call and we came as fast as we could.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin! Kevin, what are you doing? Can't you see they're here to help us? Can't you see they're human?

title: The Survivors
line: Go back in the house, Rishon. This could be some kind of a trick.

title: The Survivors
line: We'd almost given up hope. We were afraid maybe the whole Federation had been attacked.

title: The Survivors
line: What about the colony? Do you know of any other survivors?

title: The Survivors
line: It's been days since we've seen or heard from anybody. No, don't. Don't tell me that we're the only ones.

title: The Survivors
line: They came in a spaceship so big you could see it in orbit. They took our world apart piece by piece.

title: The Survivors
line: Who?

title: The Survivors
line: We don't know. We never saw their faces.

title: The Survivors
line: You don't know where they came from? Where they are now?

title: The Survivors
line: I guess they've gone away.

title: The Survivors
line: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm only performing a physical. Could I have your names, please, just for the record.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm Rishon Uxbridge and this is my husband Kevin.

title: The Survivors
line: Botanists. Originally from the aquatic city New Martim Vaz in Earth's Atlantic Ocean. Residents of the Rana Four colony for five years. You, ma'am, are eighty two years of age and a composer of Tao classical music. You, sir, are eighty five years of age and a specialist in symbiotic plant life. You have been married for fifty three years. I memorized the colony register on the way to Rana Four, in the event that such information would be needed.

title: The Survivors
line: Is something wrong?

title: The Survivors
line: With your permission, I'd like to look inside of the house.

title: The Survivors
line: Why? What could interest you in there?

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Uxbridge, as far as we've been able to determine, you and your wife and this house are all that survived that attack. That's was either a bizarre coincidence or by design, and I don't favor the coincidence theory.

title: The Survivors
line: Are you saying that we were kept alive intentionally?

title: The Survivors
line: Yes.

title: The Survivors
line: I don't understand. You don't think Rishon and I did something that merited survival, do you? I mean, betrayed the others?

title: The Survivors
line: I'm not accusing you of anything, Mister Uxbridge. The attacking force spared you for some reason. We'd like to know why. Now, may I go inside?

title: The Survivors
line: I'll make everyone a nice cup of tea. We have lovely tea here on Rana. It grows wild nearly every

title: The Survivors
line: Sir. May I say your attempt to hold the away team at bay with a nonfunctioning weapon was an act of unmitigated gall.

title: The Survivors
line: Didn't fool you, huh?

title: The Survivors
line: I admire gall.

title: The Survivors
line: Go ahead, pick it up. It's a music box. It's been in my family for generations.

title: The Survivors
line: There's nothing unusual about this house, except the fact that it's here. What about them?

title: The Survivors
line: They're in reasonably good health. Both show signs of stress, which is understandable considering what they've been through.

title: The Survivors
line: Somehow, they're different. Let's get back to the ship. We'll take them with us. Excuse, Mrs. Uxbridge. We'd better return to our ship now.

title: The Survivors
line: But I haven't finished fixing your tea, Commander.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm sorry, but we're finished here. Now, I can allow time for you and Kevin to pack.

title: The Survivors
line: What do you mean, pack?

title: The Survivors
line: You're not thinking of taking us with you, are you?

title: The Survivors
line: Surely you don't want to remain here? How can you take care of yourselves?

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin, I can't leave my home. Don't let them do this to us.

title: The Survivors
line: No one's going to make us leave.

title: The Survivors
line: You'll be protected on our ship. You could still be in danger here on Rana.

title: The Survivors
line: Commander, we appreciate your concern but we're not going anywhere. We'll manage. We always have.

title: The Survivors
line: All right. I can't make you come with us. Are you familiar with one of these? We'll be in the system for the next several days at least. If you reconsider, please contact us.

title: The Survivors
line: We'll be fine, Commander. We have each other.

title: The Survivors
line: Are they collaborators? Did they provide the colony's assailants with something that abetted the total destruction of Rana Four in order to protect their own lives?

title: The Survivors
line: What could two botanists in their eighties possess that could possibly aid whoever attacked the planet?

title: The Survivors
line: We don't know what the enemy needed, Doctor. Love? Fear? Hope?

title: The Survivors
line: Maybe they're being held hostage in some fashion?

title: The Survivors
line: Nothing in the tricorder readings indicated they were under that kind of stress.

title: The Survivors
line: Counselor? Counselor Troi?

title: The Survivors
line: I'm sorry. I don't sense them well enough.

title: The Survivors
line: Number One, you say the couple is incapable of sustaining themselves?

title: The Survivors
line: There's a fusion reactor in the house, good for another five years of power. But their water table is tainted. They have nothing to feed themselves except for a small garden.

title: The Survivors
line: They won't come to the ship?

title: The Survivors
line: They were adamant.

title: The Survivors
line: We'll do all that we can to help them but in the meantime I want them kept under surveillance.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm sorry, I'm not feeling very well. I'd like to go to my quarters.

title: The Survivors
line: By all means.

title: The Survivors
line: Is there anything I can do?

title: The Survivors
line: Captain, a search of the Ranian system has determined that the hostile force that attacked this planet is no longer present.

title: The Survivors
line: I remember a Starfleet admiral once saying the same thing about some renegade Andorians in the Triangulum system. It turns out that they had dismantled their ship and hidden it.

title: The Survivors
line: Those Andorians did not have to contend with someone of my thoroughness. I will stake my reputation.

title: The Survivors
line: Don't listen. Think of something else. Stop! Please, stop!

title: The Survivors
line: Yes?

title: The Survivors
line: I was concerned. I came to see if I could be of any help.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm fine. There's nothing wrong. I'm just tired, that's all.

title: The Survivors
line: Now, I may not have your gifts at reading emotions, Counselor, but I can tell when someone is in pain and hiding it.

title: The Survivors
line: It's so silly. I hear music. In my mind. Music that won't stop.

title: The Survivors
line: Perhaps it's a symptom of fatigue. We've all been inflicted one time or another with that melody that won't go away.

title: The Survivors
line: No, it's deeper than that. The song doesn't stops for an instant. It plays in perfect clarity from beginning to end over and over again. I don't even know what song it is. I never heard it before.

title: The Survivors
line: When did this start?

title: The Survivors
line: A few hours ago, while the away team was on the surface. I was trying to, I was thinking of Rishon and Kevin.

title: The Survivors
line: Rishon and Kevin? And?

title: The Survivors
line: I can't explain it, Captain. They're elusive. They're, I'm sorry

title: The Survivors
line: Well, try and rest. Take the necessary sleep inducements if you have to.

title: The Survivors
line: Data, give us a visual. Magnification factor fifty.

title: The Survivors
line: Look at the size of that!

title: The Survivors
line: Now where did that come from?

title: The Survivors
line: Apparently it was riding a Lagrange point, hiding behind Rana Four's furthest moon.

title: The Survivors
line: Our vehicle classification index can put no identity to it. Its design is completely foreign.

title: The Survivors
line: But that's our boy. Approximately five times our mass and carrying enough armament to pulverize a planet.

title: The Survivors
line: Lieutenant?

title: The Survivors
line: I, er, cannot explain this, Captain.

title: The Survivors
line: It's heading for the planet.

title: The Survivors
line: Hailing frequencies.

title: The Survivors
line: Open.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Data, ask them to identify themselves and match our orbit.

title: The Survivors
line: They have received the message, Captain, but are ignoring it.

title: The Survivors
line: Maximum shields, ready all weapon systems.

title: The Survivors
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Survivors
line: It's assuming an attack posture. Don't be surprised if

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel is firing jacketed streams of positrons and antiprotons. Equivalent firepower, forty megawatts. Shields are holding. Again, forty megawatts. No damage.

title: The Survivors
line: If that's the best they can do, this should last about five minutes.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Worf, let's raise our voice a little. Fire phasers. Just a warning shot. Mister Data, invite them to stand to.

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel has assumed a position outside of the Rana system, and it is rapidly increasing velocity.

title: The Survivors
line: Helm, initiate pursuit.

title: The Survivors
line: Aye, sir. The vessel has reached warp two and continues on a steady acceleration curve. We're not getting any closer, Commander.

title: The Survivors
line: Give us a superior curve, Mister Crusher.

title: The Survivors
line: Warp three. Warp four. The warship continues to match our curve simultaneously point for point. Warp four point five. Warp five. Warp five point five.

title: The Survivors
line: Riker to La Forge. Give us everything you can to close the gap, Geordi.

title: The Survivors
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Survivors
line: I'll get you to nine point three seven in fifteen seconds.

title: The Survivors
line: Warp eight point five. Warp nine. The warship continues to match our acceleration curve perfectly.

title: The Survivors
line: Number One, I have the distinct impression that we're being toyed with. Take us back to Rana Four.

title: The Survivors
line: Back?

title: The Survivors
line: We have unfinished business there. I need to have a talk with those two people. You have the Bridge.

title: The Survivors
line: Reduce speed. Bring us around on a return course. This one's getting away.

title: The Survivors
line: Good afternoon. I'm sorry if I startled you. I'm Jean-Luc Picard, Captain of the Enterprise. I have brought you something you will need if you're going to stay on Rana Four. It's a matter replicator. It has limited capabilities, but

title: The Survivors
line: Thank you, but we have no use for such a thing.

title: The Survivors
line: It will provide you with clothing, food and clean water. Lieutenant Worf demonstrate its operation.

title: The Survivors
line: We don't need it.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin, you know we do. Thank you, Captain. Kevin and I were about to have afternoon tea. You and Mister Worf must join us.

title: The Survivors
line: I'd like that very much.

title: The Survivors
line: Rishon, they only want to spy on us like this morning.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin Uxbridge, I have never turned anyone away from this house, and I'm not going to start now. Captain.

title: The Survivors
line: Thank you.

title: The Survivors
line: Stop! Stop! Please, I'll do anything! Make it stop!

title: The Survivors
line: Please. I'm here to help.

title: The Survivors
line: It's so loud! It's getting louder! Please, I can't stand it. Make it stop!

title: The Survivors
line: Move her to the bed.

title: The Survivors
line: This will help you relax.

title: The Survivors
line: I hear it. It's still there! It's so loud!

title: The Survivors
line: Take her to Sickbay.

title: The Survivors
line: No, I want to stay in my quarters.

title: The Survivors
line: I can get you to sleep.

title: The Survivors
line: I don't want to sleep. The music will only follow me.

title: The Survivors
line: I can induce delta sleep. Lock out even your deepest dreams.

title: The Survivors
line: It's not a dream. It's real.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin and I first saw each other on a ship at sea. He was a starving student with this threadbare suit and mismatched shoes. I was traveling with my parents who did not like the way that he kept hanging around. Two hours after I met him, I asked him to marry me. And he knew I was serious. I don't think that he has ever recovered from that day.

title: The Survivors
line: Well, what do you think, Mister Worf?

title: The Survivors
line: Good tea. Nice house.

title: The Survivors
line: Why did you leave the Earth and come to a brand new planet when you did?

title: The Survivors
line: You mean at our age. Well, we thought it might make us fall in love all over again. It worked.

title: The Survivors
line: Must have been terrible when the colony was fighting for its life.

title: The Survivors
line: Yes, it was. Fires lit the sky. There was thunder, this unbelievable thunder. The ground never stopped shaking.

title: The Survivors
line: And yet you survived.

title: The Survivors
line: We don't know why we survived and the others didn't. I've tried to put some purpose to it, but I can't.

title: The Survivors
line: I was wondering, Captain, when you and your ship would be leaving.

title: The Survivors
line: I don't have an answer for that. A few hours ago, we encountered a warship. Possibly the one which attacked you. We forced it to leave the system but we were unable to affect it otherwise. It could return.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin, you said it had gone away.

title: The Survivors
line: I guess I was wrong. Don't worry. It didn't hurt us before, it won't hurt us now.

title: The Survivors
line: Do you know that for a fact, Kevin?

title: The Survivors
line: No, but I don't enjoy seeing my wife frightened. We've told you time and time again, we don't know why we were spared.

title: The Survivors
line: But there had to be some reason. In some way, you were different from the other colonists. Your geographical location, your philosophical beliefs, the color of your eyes. In some way you were set apart from them.

title: The Survivors
line: There was a difference. I'm a man of special conscience. While the others were doing what they could, I chose not to fight.

title: The Survivors
line: Well that is your protected right.

title: The Survivors
line: But I can assure you the attacking ship had no way of realizing this. I expected to die like all the others. There's no reason for you and your ship to remain, Captain. We can manage without you.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin grieved for the others, Captain, but he did nothing. He is a very gentle man. You must understand that.

title: The Survivors
line: What about you, Rishon? Is that how you feel?

title: The Survivors
line: I wanted to fight but I stayed with my husband. Well, Captain, thank you again for the replicator. I'd better clean up now.

title: The Survivors
line: Before we leave, I ask you one more time to come to the ship. For your own safety.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain, I am frightened but I can't leave Rana, even if it means my life.

title: The Survivors
line: I don't understand it. I've inhibited almost all the activity of the neocortex and she continues to behave as if she's hearing the music. We're going to have to shield her from all outside stimuli by inducing coma.

title: The Survivors
line: I have a positive identification, Commander. It is the vessel that attacked us earlier. It is re-entering the system at high velocity and is approaching Rana Four.

title: The Survivors
line: Give us a tight visual, Data. Is it my imagination or does it look a lot meaner this time? Shields up. Weapons ready.

title: The Survivors
line: Our friend is back.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm not surprised. Mister Worf, open a hailing frequency. Warn the vessel to stay clear of the planet.

title: The Survivors
line: Aye, sir, but they are already within firing range.

title: The Survivors
line: Shields are down. Captain, they hit us with four hundred gigawatts of particle energy.

title: The Survivors
line: Damage?

title: The Survivors
line: Superficial, but I'm having trouble reassembling the shields. Shields down. There is thermal damage to the hull.

title: The Survivors
line: The warship is capable of striking us with far more powerful bursts.

title: The Survivors
line: They're maneuvering to come between the Enterprise and Rana Four.

title: The Survivors
line: Number One, we have been exemplary in our patience.

title: The Survivors
line: Lieutenant Worf, fire phasers on full with a simultaneous spread of torpedoes.

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel appears undamaged, sir. Its defenses are apparently able to absorb incoming matter and energy.

title: The Survivors
line: Commence rapid fire with all weapons on full.

title: The Survivors
line: Shields down. Internal damage. Weapon systems control has been lost.

title: The Survivors
line: Riker to Sickbay. Medical assistance to the Bridge!

title: The Survivors
line: On our way, Commander.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Crusher, move the Enterprise out of range of the attacking vessel.

title: The Survivors
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Worf?

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel has terminated its pursuit. It is assuming an orbit around Rana Four.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin and Rishon?

title: The Survivors
line: We can't help them. But it's my guess they're in no danger.

title: The Survivors
line: Number of casualties?

title: The Survivors
line: Sixty-six.

title: The Survivors
line: Fatalities?

title: The Survivors
line: None. We've been able to treat everyone.

title: The Survivors
line: Can you help her?

title: The Survivors
line: I've done everything I can. I don't understand the nature of this music she says she's hearing, or where it's coming from.

title: The Survivors
line: Could it be telepathic?

title: The Survivors
line: Yes. But I'm not the expert at determining that.

title: The Survivors
line: They're blocking her sensitivity. They're stopping her from seeing the truth.

title: The Survivors
line: Who's stopping her?

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin and Rishon.

title: The Survivors
line: What?

title: The Survivors
line: They wanted us to leave Rana and that's exactly what we're doing. Picard to Bridge.

title: The Survivors
line: Yes, Captain.

title: The Survivors
line: Number One, I want you to maintain this course for another hour

title: The Survivors
line: And then turn the Enterprise around and take it back to Rana Four.

title: The Survivors
line: We still won't have our shields restored by then.

title: The Survivors
line: Take it back, Number One, and this time nothing is going to lure us away.

title: The Survivors
line: Sir, sensors indicate no spacecraft in the vicinity of Rana Four. But, Captain

title: The Survivors
line: Forget your previous error, Mister Worf. There is no way you could have prevented it.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain, the Uxbridge house is coming into transporter range.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Worf, will you accompany me to the Transporter Room? You have the Bridge, Number One.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain, I think you should reconsider. The warship has come after us twice. It could come back.

title: The Survivors
line: I disagree, Number One. I don't think it knows we're here. I think it believes that it has run us off for good. However, that will all change once I'm back on board.

title: The Survivors
line: Sir?

title: The Survivors
line: It's protecting Kevin and Rishon. It responds to their wishes. Indirectly or directly, I'm not sure, but that's what I'm going to put to the test.

title: The Survivors
line: Celebrating?

title: The Survivors
line: What are you doing here? What do you want?

title: The Survivors
line: This is the second time that you have shown surprise at my appearance, Kevin. The first time was understandable, but now? Unless it is because you never expected to see me again.

title: The Survivors
line: Why do you keep interfering with our lives, Captain?

title: The Survivors
line: It is not my intention to interfere. Only to help you and Rishon.

title: The Survivors
line: Then please, leave us alone.

title: The Survivors
line: I promise you that when I leave this house I will never set foot in it again. But the Enterprise will remain in orbit over the planet.

title: The Survivors
line: Why?

title: The Survivors
line: To protect you.

title: The Survivors
line: That's not necessary. I thought you understood.

title: The Survivors
line: It is necessary. You're in great danger. A warship has returned.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin!

title: The Survivors
line: He's lying, Rishon.

title: The Survivors
line: We have fought a pitched battle with it, and lost. Many of my crew have been injured including a woman who's mind is slowly being destroyed by telepathic manipulation.

title: The Survivors
line: No. Please no.

title: The Survivors
line: This is a form of intimidation. I have my rights.

title: The Survivors
line: Your rights? What about Rishon? Is she in favor of being here left here? Come to the Enterprise. Let me take you where you'll be safe.

title: The Survivors
line: No. I can't leave Kevin.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm staying. She's safe here with me. in this house.

title: The Survivors
line: Why are you safe?. Why is this house a sanctuary? Does it have to do with you? With your refusal to fight? Tell me this. If Rishon were in danger, would you kill to save her life?

title: The Survivors
line: No, not for her. Not for anyone. I will not kill.

title: The Survivors
line: Please stop hurting him. Captain, leave our house.

title: The Survivors
line: It is my sworn duty to protect you. The Enterprise will remain in orbit around Rana Four as long as the two of you are alive.

title: The Survivors
line: Number One, an update, please.

title: The Survivors
line: Little change, Captain. Our shields are still inoperable. We have partial control of our weapons, and I've doubled the repair crews.

title: The Survivors
line: The warship is approaching from high orbit. It is very close three hundred thousand kilometers distant.

title: The Survivors
line: How is that possible? Is something wrong with the sensors?

title: The Survivors
line: That's no concern, Number One. It's here and it's precisely on schedule.

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel has altered its course to a direct intercept with the Enterprise.

title: The Survivors
line: Worf, arm phasers and photon torpedoes. Prepare to fire.

title: The Survivors
line: Belay those orders, Mister Worf.

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel is now within twenty thousand kilometers of the Enterprise and closing.

title: The Survivors
line: Let it come, let it come. Activate the main viewer.

title: The Survivors
line: Evasive action, sir?

title: The Survivors
line: The Enterprise will hold its position, Mister Worf.

title: The Survivors
line: Weapons, sir?

title: The Survivors
line: On my orders, not before.

title: The Survivors
line: The vessel is entering a low orbit around Rana Four. It appears it is preparing to fire at the planet, Captain.

title: The Survivors
line: Understood.

title: The Survivors
line: My calculations indicate that its target is the house of Kevin and Rishon Uxbridge.

title: The Survivors
line: There will be no interference from us, Mister Data.

title: The Survivors
line: The house has been obliterated.

title: The Survivors
line: Scan for survivors.

title: The Survivors
line: There are no survivors.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Worf, prepare a photon torpedo. Fire at the enemy vessel when ready.

title: The Survivors
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Survivors
line: Number One, what reason does the Enterprise have for remaining at Rana?

title: The Survivors
line: The unknown vessel has been destroyed. The Uxbridges have been destroyed. There's no reason for the Enterprise to remain.

title: The Survivors
line: Good. Helm, move us into a higher orbit so that we may keep the surface of the planet under surveillance.

title: The Survivors
line: Aye, sir. But, Captain, what are we watching for?

title: The Survivors
line: Anything. Everything. I'll be in my Ready room if I'm needed. That will be all for now.

title: The Survivors
line: Come.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain, may I speak with you?

title: The Survivors
line: It's my pleasure, Number One.

title: The Survivors
line: We've been observing the planet very carefully for three hours. We've seen nothing. I have the feeling you're waiting for something to happen.

title: The Survivors
line: Your Captain is acting on an assumption, Will, and I'm not sure what the result will be, or even that my assumption is correct. We found two people alive in a house on a devastated planet. But there was only one survivor of the war on Rana Four.

title: The Survivors
line: Why is it we maintain watch on a planet that is now totally dead?

title: The Survivors
line: Bridge to Captain Picard. You had better come see this.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain. Commander. The house is back. Trees, grass, everything. Happened right in front of us.

title: The Survivors
line: Mister Worf, do you see any survivors?

title: The Survivors
line: I detect two life forms inside the house. It appears Kevin and Rishon were not destroyed.

title: The Survivors
line: Helm, take us within transporter range. We're going to beam them aboard directly onto the Bridge.

title: The Survivors
line: But, Captain, will they not protest?

title: The Survivors
line: Let them.

title: The Survivors
line: My apologies if I interrupted a waltz.

title: The Survivors
line: Why have you brought us here against our will?

title: The Survivors
line: I want to end the suffering of one of my crewmembers.

title: The Survivors
line: I don't understand.

title: The Survivors
line: Kevin does. He's the cause. At first I couldn't understand why your house survived the holocaust when the others hadn't. Then it occurred to me. It had been destroyed. That dwelling, where you served me tea, where you danced your waltzes, is a reproduction. Real to the touch but capable of being created, destroyed, and created. All on a whim.

title: The Survivors
line: You're joking with us, Captain. Can't you see this is hurting my husband?

title: The Survivors
line: Rishon. Hear what he has to say.

title: The Survivors
line: More than anything else, you wanted the Enterprise away from Rana, because the house, the plot of land, your very existence, were incongruities that you were not prepared to explain. The warship, another recreation, tried to chase us away twice, and failed. But when I came to your house the second time, I provided you with the only condition that would make the Enterprise leave. Your deaths. You did your best to satisfy that condition.

title: The Survivors
line: I'm deeply sorry about the woman. I will help her. But I must know what you intend to do with me afterwards.

title: The Survivors
line: You'll be taken to the nearest starbase and held responsible for the attack on the Enterprise, and possibly the deaths of eleven thousand people.

title: The Survivors
line: No. He never killed anyone.

title: The Survivors
line: The destruction of the planet happened just as I told you.

title: The Survivors
line: But you haven't told us the whole story. How it ended. The part about Rishon.

title: The Survivors
line: What is he saying?

title: The Survivors
line: Rishon, I can touch you. I can hear your voice, I can smell your perfume. In every respect you are a real person with your own mind and beliefs, but you do not exist. You died along with the others, defending the colony. He recreated you, just as he recreated the house.

title: The Survivors
line: You are the only living thing that really exists on Rana. And though you look human, you're not.

title: The Survivors
line: He's in the turbolift.

title: The Survivors
line: Let him go.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain, he is dangerous!

title: The Survivors
line: So dangerous, Mister Worf, that he could have destroyed us in an instant had he wished. Track him. Alert the crew to keep clear of hm. I want him to understand we mean him no harm

title: The Survivors
line: Will he return to the planet?

title: The Survivors
line: If he is the creature of conscience I believe him to be, he has someone to help first.

title: The Survivors
line: I've taken the music from her mind. She's alright now. She's sleeping. She was beginning to sense who I really was. I've been living as a human for over fifty years but I couldn't hide from her. She has suffered because of my pride and selfishness. It will not happen again.

title: The Survivors
line: What happened on Rana Four? The truth this time. All of it.

title: The Survivors
line: Very well. For what it's worth. I am a Douwd. An immortal being of disguises and false surroundings. I have lived in this galaxy for many thousands of years although until today, no one has known my true identity. Once, while traveling in human form, I chanced to fall in love with an Earth woman. I put aside my powers and became her husband. Our life was happy and rich. Eventually we came to this planet to live our final years. Now she is dead. She never knew what I really was.

title: The Survivors
line: Your colony was attacked by a warship.

title: The Survivors
line: Belonging to the Husnock, a species of hideous intelligence who knew only aggression and destruction. I could have destroyed them with a mere thought, but I did not do so.

title: The Survivors
line: You had the power to stop them but you didn't?

title: The Survivors
line: I refused to for the same reason I refused to stop the Enterprise. I will not kill.

title: The Survivors
line: So you let the colonists fight a hopeless battle.

title: The Survivors
line: I tried to fool the Husnock as I tried to fool you. It only made them angrier. More cruel.

title: The Survivors
line: And then what you most feared, happened. Rishon went to fight with the colonists, and died with them.

title: The Survivors
line: How I wish I could have died with her.

title: The Survivors
line: But you couldn't. You were left alone.

title: The Survivors
line: Yes. I saw her broken body. I went insane. My hatred exploded, and in an instant of grief I destroyed the Husnock.

title: The Survivors
line: Why did you try to hide this from all of us? Was it out of guilt for not helping Rishon and the others when they were alive?

title: The Survivors
line: No, no, no, no. You don't understand the scope of my crime. I didn't kill just one Husnock, or a hundred, or a thousand. I killed them all. All Husnock everywhere. Are eleven thousand people worth fifty billion? Is the love of a woman worth the destruction of an entire species? This is the sin I tried so hard to keep you from learning now. Why I wanted to chase you from Rana.

title: The Survivors
line: We're not qualified to be your judges. We have no law to fit your crime. You're free to return to the planet and to make Rishon live again.

title: The Survivors
line: Helm, break orbit. Full impulse.

title: The Survivors
line: Captain's log, Stardate 43153.7. We are departing the Rana system for Starbase One Three Three. We leave behind a being of extraordinary power and conscience. I am not certain if he should be praised or condemned. Only that he should be left alone.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Captain's log, Stardate 43173.5. We are en route to Mintaka Three, where a three man Federation anthropological field team has been studying the inhabitants. Our mission is to resupply the outpost and repair their malfunctioning reactor.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Mister La Forge, report.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We've finished replicating the parts they'll need, but what I don't understand is why a three man station would need a reactor capable of producing four point two gigawatts.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Enough to power a small phaser bank, a subspace relay station, or

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: A hologram generator. Oh, a duck blind. Right. They're anthropologists.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Who are studying an extended family of Mintakans at close range from a camouflaged observation post.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: According to Doctor Barron's preliminary reports, the Mintakans are proto-Vulcan humanoids at the Bronze Age level. Quite peaceful and highly rational.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Which is not surprising, considering how closely their evolution parallels Vulcan.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Captain, incoming transmission from Mintaka Three.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Thank you, Lieutenant. On screen.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Barron to Enterprise. Our temporary repairs have failed. The reactor is now inoperative.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Do you have battery backup?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Three hours at best.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Captain, if we increase to warp seven we can be there in twenty three minutes.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Make it so. We're on our way.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We've lost contact, sir.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Increase to warp nine.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The framework's still charged, so watch it.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Why did we have to come so early?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: When the sun reaches its zenith, I have to be ready to take the measurements.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You'll be ready. You've read the sundial hundreds of times.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Yes, father, but never as the appointed record keeper.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You're taking your duties quite seriously. Your mother would have been proud of you.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: What is that? Up there, father. What is it?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I don't know.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Keep work. Palmer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's all right. It's all right.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The hologram generator is now functioning, sir.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: All we need now is power.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Almost there.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You wait here, Oji.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Enterprise, beam Martinez and his patient directly to Sickbay.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Commander.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Doctor, be careful.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I've got to get down there.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Crusher to Enterprise. Medical emergency. Two to beam directly to Sickbay.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Aye, Doctor.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That should do it.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You increased the levels of tricordrazine? Let me see his chart, please.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Doctor Crusher.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Before you start quoting me the Prime Directive, he'd already seen us. The damage was done. It was either bring him aboard or let him die.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Then why didn't you let him die?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Because we were responsible for his injuries.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I'm not sure that I concur with that reasoning, Doctor. But now that he's here, you must remove all memory of his encounter with the away team.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: By erasing short term recall?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It has been accomplished before.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I am familiar with Doctor Pulaski's technique. I can't guarantee it will be effective on Mintakan brain chemistry. Their lie-zone levels are much lower.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Wait. No! No! We must evacuate.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Doctor Barron, you're on the Enterprise. You're safe.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The others?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Doctor Warren is here. We're doing all we can.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And Palmer? Where is Palmer?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Still on Mintaka Three.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard, you have to find him.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We will.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: He may be hurt.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Rest assured we shall not leave until he is located.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Thank you, Picard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard to bridge. Report.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Scans of the planet detect no humans, Captain.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Very well. Put us into a close orbit.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Sir, a close orbit will increase sensor efficiency by only four percent.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I want that four percent, Lieutenant.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Aye, sir.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard out.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Damn.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Well, Doctor. Your next task is clear.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Oji? Oji?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Father?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Here. Oji.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Father! I thought I'd never see you again. When you and the woman vanished, I was sure you were dead.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I think I was, but I was brought back to life. Oji, I awoke in an incredible place and my wounds were gone. I had been healed.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: How is that possible?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Long ago, our people believed in beings with great powers. These beings made the rains come, told the sun when to rise, they caused all life to be born, to grow, to die.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: But those are just tales, father. Old superstitions.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: But perhaps the beliefs of our ancestors are true. Nothing else can explain what's happened. Everything is changed now, Oji. We must tell the others.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Barron is stable, but Warren is still critical.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Palmer is missing. A scan of the planet shows Mintakan life forms only, no humans. However

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The area around the duck blind exhibits Karst topography. Sinkholes, underground rivers, and caverns. And the rock strata contain a high concentration of thallium compounds which may be obstructing our sensor beams.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: So if Palmer, in his delirium, fled into a cave, we may be unable to detect his life signs?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Correct, sir.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Captain, if he is still alive, he needs medical attention. We must send an away team to locate him.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: But our presence must not interfere with the cultural development of the Mintakans.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Agreed. Further contamination must be prevented.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I have a suggestion. First officer's log, Stardate 43174.2. Counselor Troi and I are beaming down to Mintaka Three to locate Doctor Palmer and to determine the extent of the cultural contamination. Doctor Crusher has temporarily altered our features and skin color. She's also implanted subcutaneous communicators so that any transmissions we receive will be inaudible to the Mintakans.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Riker to Enterprise. Do you hear me?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Perfectly, Commander. I will be monitoring you continuously.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Mintakan emotions are quite interesting. Like the Vulcans, they have highly ordered minds. A very sensible people. For example, Mintakan women precede their mates. It's a signal to other women.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: This man's taken, get your own?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Not precisely. More like, if you want his services, I'm the one you have to negotiate with.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: What kind of services?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: All kinds.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: They are a sensible race.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I understand your skepticism. Had it not happened to me, I would find it difficult to accept as well.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: But it did happen, just as we've said.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Fento, you know the legends better than anyone. Do they not speak of beings like the kind I've seen?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Who could vanish like smoke?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: There are the stories of the Overseer who could appear and disappear at will.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And couldn't this Overseer heal the dead?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: He had supreme power, or so our ancestors believed.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I believe I have seen the Overseer. He is called the Picard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Uh oh.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: His memory's intact.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The procedure didn't work.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Liko, all this talk of supernatural beings. No one has believed that for countless generations. Just as we no longer believe the stars control our fates, or the spirits of the dead haunt the living.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Nuria, I'm not saying all the old beliefs are true. But I did see the Picard, and I was restored back to life.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We are visitors. We've come to trade our cloth. May we speak?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Please do. We welcome outsiders. I am Nuria.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I am Troi and this is Riker. You've had a very interesting dream.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Dream? It was real!

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: My father and I both witnessed these beings.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: If you are father and daughter, you may well have shared the same dream.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That is not reasonable.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Is that any less reasonable than being magically transformed to another place by the Picard?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Nuria!

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It has to be Palmer! The one the Picard wished to find.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Remarkable. You were speaking the truth.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The Picard will be pleased.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Riker to Picard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Go ahead, Number One.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We have a problem.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: With the contamination?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's worse than we suspected.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The Mintakans are beginning to believe in a god

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And the one they've chosen is you.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard, you must beam Palmer aboard immediately. Without medical attention

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's not as simple as that. He is surrounded by Mintakans. If he dematerializes before their eyes, the impact

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It will slightly increase the cultural contamination which already exists. A small price for saving Palmer's life.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Number One?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Is there any chance of your freeing Palmer and transporting up unseen?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We can try.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Try hard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard out.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Picard, I must protest. You're endangering Palmer with this delay.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I am aware of that. But each of us, including Doctor Palmer took an oath that we would uphold the Prime Directive, if necessary, with our lives.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Riga and I were hunting on the third ridge. We followed a hornbuck into a cave. The stranger was there, asleep.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: This Palmer is one of the Overseer's servants?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Yes. The Picard has many servants. Isn't that true, Fento?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: According to legend. But if this Palmer is a servant of the Overseer, what was he doing in the cave?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Perhaps he ran away.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Or he failed the Picard somehow and was hiding from him.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We should bind him in case he wakes and tries to escape.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's senseless for this stranger to be held captive. All this talk of the Overseer, it's old superstitions.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I disagree. All the evidence indicates that the Overseer exists.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And I heard the Picard say he wanted to find Palmer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Then by keeping Palmer safe, we will please the Picard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And he'll grant us favors in return.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Favors?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It is said that the Overseer is all powerful. He can provide gentle winters, plentiful hunting, fertile crops, anything.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: He could even bring back those who have died.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's agreed. We will save Palmer for the Picard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I've seen another one, like Palmer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Another servant of the Picard?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: He's headed toward the caves.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Fento, stay and bind Palmer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Where?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Over there.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That knot won't hold. If I may?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Please do.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You need a knot that'll tighten under pressure. Let me show you.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Father, the sun's reaching its zenith. If I don't go to measure

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Go.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Forgive me, friend, but the stranger must be set free.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Riker?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Riker to Enterprise. Lock on and prepare to beam us directly to Sickbay, but hang on for my signal.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Acknowledged, Commander.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Riker, stop!

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Oji?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's Riker, he's taking Palmer!

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Hali. Yuri, don't let her escape.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I'm clear. Energize!

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Data, has Counselor Troi beamed up?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Negative, Commander. Sensors show she's in the midst of a group of Mintakans.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Damn.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: He is all right. Hali, find Riker and Palmer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Why did you and Riker take Palmer from us?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We did not take Palmer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We set him free. Riker and I do not believe in these fables about an Overseer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Don't you realize what you've done? You've angered the Picard and we may all suffer for it. I know. I've seen him. He is all-powerful.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Fanto, weren't there stories about the Overseer destroying those who offended him?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Stories, nothing more.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Liko, we'll get Palmer back. Riker was carrying him. They can't have gone far.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Still, the Picard may blame us for letting Palmer escape. Perhaps we should punish her. Let the Overseer know

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That she and Riker acted alone.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: We will keep Troi captive.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That's not enough.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You would have us harm her?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: If it will hold off the Picard's anger, yes. I've seen how powerful he is.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I am unwilling to hurt her needlessly. We will wait for Hali to return.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And if they don't find Palmer?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Then we may have to do as Liko suggests.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Doctor, you believe the Mintakans are capable of harming Counselor Troi?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: They are not normally a violent people but these are extraordinary circumstances. They're trying to comprehend what they believe to be a god.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Recommendations?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The Mintakans wish to please the Overseer, but they can only guess what he wants. They need a sign.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Are you suggesting?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You must go down to Mintaka Three.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Masquerading as a god?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Absolutely out of the question. The Prime Directive

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Has already been violated. The damage is done. All we can do now is minimize it.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: By sanctioning their false beliefs?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: By giving them guidelines. Letting them know what the Overseer expects of them.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Doctor Barron, I cannot, I will not, impose a set of commandments on these people. To do so violates the very essence of the Prime Directive.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Like it or not, we have rekindled the Mintakans' belief in the Overseer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And are you saying that this belief will eventually become a religion?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: It's inevitable. And without guidance, that religion could degenerate into inquisitions, holy wars, chaos.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Horrifying. Doctor Barron, your report describes how rational these people are. Millennia ago, they abandoned their belief in the supernatural. Now you are asking me to sabotage that achievement, to send them back into the Dark Ages of superstition and ignorance and fear? No! We will find some way to undo the damage we've caused. Number One, tell me about this group's leader.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Nuria. Exceptionally clear-minded, sensible. The Mintakans trust her judgment. If we can convince her that you are not a god

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: She might be able to persuade the others.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: And how do you propose to convince her?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: She believes the Picard is a magical figure. I'm going to show her how the magic works. I'm going to bring her aboard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Counselor, sensors indicate five Mintakans in your immediate vicinity. Four are motionless. The fifth is eight meters away, proceeding south. Is Nuria one of these five?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Mmm hmm.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Was that intended to be an affirmative?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Yes, Data, it was.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Is Nuria the closest of the five?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Uh un.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Negative.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Is Nuria the one in motion?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Mmm hmm.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Lock sensors on Nuria.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Locked on. We can beam Nuria aboard at will.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Data, when sensors indicate she's alone, beam her directly to transporter room one.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Aye, sir.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Ensign Hoy?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Captain, Nuria is alone.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I'll handle this.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Nuria, don't be afraid. No one is going to harm you.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Who?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I am Jean Luc Picard.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Please, get up. Get up. You must not kneel to me.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: You do not wish it?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I do not deserve it. Look at me. Look at me. Feel the warmth of my hand, the rhythm of my pulse. I'm not a supreme being. I'm flesh and blood, like you.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Not like me.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Like you. Different in appearance, yes. But we are both living beings. We are born, we grow, we live and we die. In all the ways that matter, we are alike.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: But you are the Picard!

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: There is something I want you to see.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: What a wondrous place. Even the walls obey your command.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Wondrous, yes, but not miraculous. The doors merely work differently from the ones you know.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That is my home?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Seen from far, far above.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Yet we do not fall. I never imagined I would see the clouds from the other side. Your powers are truly boundless.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Nuria, your people live in huts. Was it always so?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: No. We have found remnants of tools in caves. Our ancestors must have lived there.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: So why do you now live in huts?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Huts are better. Caves are dark and wet.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: If huts are better, why did you once live in caves?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: The most reasonable explanation would be that at one time we didn't know how to make huts.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Just as at one time you did not know how to weave cloth, how to make a bow.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: That would be reasonable.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Someone invented a hut. Someone invented a bow, who taught others, who taught their children, who built a stronger hut, built a better bow, who taught their children. Now, Nuria, suppose one of your cave dwelling ancestors could see you as you are today. What would she think?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I don't know.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Put yourself in her place. You see, she cannot kill a hornbuck at a great distance. You can. You have a power she lacks.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Only because I have a bow.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: She's never seen a bow. It doesn't exist in her world. To you, it's a simple tool. To her, it's magic.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I suppose she might think so.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Now, how would she react to you?

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I think she would fear me.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Just as you fear me.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: I do not fear you any longer.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Good. That's good. You see, my people once lived in caves. And then we learned to build huts and, in time, to build ships like this one.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
line: Perhaps one day, my people will travel above the skies.

title: Allegiance

title: Allegiance

title: Allegiance

title: Allegiance
line: Because I've decided to conduct an experiment of my own. I want to see how you react to being imprisoned.

title: Allegiance

title: Allegiance
line: We were merely curious. We meant no harm.

title: Allegiance
line: We did not, after all, injure you in any way.

title: Allegiance

title: Allegiance
line: And now that you have had a taste of captivity, perhaps you will reconsider the morality of inflicting it upon others. In any event, we now know about your race and we know how to imprison you. Bear that in mind. Now get off my ship.

line: About what?

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Anything we can do?

line: How so?

line: It's a classic case of stress-related ailments brought on by overwork. Exhaustion, irritability, muscle spasms. Yet he insists on ignoring them.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Impossible.

line: Jean-Luc, I could make that an order.

line: But you won't. Beverly, you know I loathe vacations.

line: You loathe going on vacations. Once you're there you have a marvelous time. You told me your four days on Zytchin Three were wonderful.

line: I lied. Look, the Enterprise is scheduled to spend a week undergoing maintenance overhaul at Starbase twelve. While there, I promise that I will make full use of available recreation activity.

title: Captain's Holiday

line: I suppose I could find a few hours to spend on the holodeck.

line: Forget the holodeck. Isn't there someplace you want to go?

line: The last thing you need is serious thought. Jean-Luc, why don't you go some place beautiful, where you can relax and be pampered. You deserve it.

line: I'll give it serious thought.

line: Captain.

line: I suppose this means I can look forward to a week of continual harassment on this subject? I admit, I've been feeling a little fatigued.

line: I think you've mistaken me for someone else.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Return. My apologies. I fear I have yet to master the art of hoverball.

line: You find me amusing.

line: No. It's just that you are the fifth woman to ask me that question this morning. All I require is to sit in the sun and read my book. Alone.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: I really haven't thought that far ahead.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Then may I suggest a swim to be followed by a massage?

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Some other time perhaps.

line: I don't even know what it means. The Horga'hn is for a friend.

line: You're blocking the suns.

line: I advise you to listen closely for I will not say this again. I came to Risa for a holiday, nothing more. I have no knowledge of this woman of whom you speak, nor have I laid eyes on any disk.

line: That's fine with me. It's not as though I was offering to help you find it.

line: I'm sorry if I embarrassed you.

line: Jean-Luc Picard.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Would you rather I guess? I can be very persistent.

line: I noticed you arguing with that Ferengi. For a moment there it looked like it was going to come to blows.

line: I hope your disagreement wasn't over me.

line: It would seem you two have a lot to discuss. If you'll excuse me.

line: We are Vorgons. I am Ajur. This is Boratus.

line: We come from the twenty seventh century. We traveled three hundred years into the past to find you.

line: All right, let's assume for the moment I believe you, that you are indeed from the future. What is it that you want from me?

line: Have you heard of the Tox Uthat?

line: What? I'm aware of the legend. It tells of a visitor from the future who left behind a mysterious device known as the Tox Uthat.

line: Essentially that story is correct.

line: Then the Uthat actually exists?

line: Yes. It was invented by a scientist named Kal Dano in the mid twenty seventh century. The Uthat is a quantum phase inhibitor capable of halting all nuclear reaction within a star.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: But why bring such a powerful weapon into the past?

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Criminals attempted to steal the device, so he fled back to the twenty second century where he hid it. Ajur and I were the security team assigned to retrieve the Uthat.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: I gather you were unsuccessful.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: Yes. When we returned we began to search through the historical records for some clue to the Uthat's fate.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: And your search led you to me?

title: Captain's Holiday
line: We came upon a brief account stating you had discovered an object of unknown origin while vacationing on Risa. From its description, a crystal cube that fits in the palm of the hand, we surmised it could very well be the Tox Uthat.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I haven't found anything, including peace, which is the only thing I'm looking for.

title: Captain's Holiday
line: You will find such a device, Captain. To us, it is already part of history.

line: I served as his personal assistant for the past five years. Shortly before he died, he uncovered new data pinpointing its location. And that disk contains his research notes and maps.

line: And now, with typical Ferengi logic, he's convinced that the Tox Uthat belongs to him.

line: All he cares about is selling it to the highest bidder.

line: Whereas you, of course, have a nobler purpose in mind.

line: I told the professor I'd present it to the Daystrom Institute for study. But first I have to find it. And that won't be easy with Sovak watching me every minute.

line: I'll meet you in the lobby in fifteen minutes. Be punctual. Oh, and I advise you to change your clothing.

line: I expected such treachery. Did you think you could sneak away from me so easily?

line: You're making a grave mistake putting your trust in this woman.

line: I'll take that as another compliment. I'm flattered.

line: You know Jean-Luc, it's lucky for you we met. If it wasn't for me, you'd still be back there sitting in the sun, relaxing.

title: The Loss

title: The Loss
