title: Aquiel
line: It was set to level ten. Standard procedure requires that all phasers are set on level one when they're in storage.

title: Aquiel
line: That means that someone deliberately changed the setting. And then there is the matter of your conflict with Lieutenant Rocha.

title: Aquiel
line: Rocha and I had our disagreements but that does not mean I would kill him.

title: Aquiel
line: Have you been able to remember anything that happened after he attacked you?

title: Aquiel
line: No. Nothing. I suppose maybe in self-defense I

title: Aquiel
line: Doctor Crusher tells me that in order to inflict the kind of molecular damage found in Rocha's remains, it would take a sustained phaser discharge of at least thirty to forty seconds. That doesn't sound like self-defense to me.

title: Aquiel
line: Now wait a minute. We haven't even established this phaser is the murder weapon yet. And even at level ten I don't see how it could have done the damage the medical evidence says it did. A phase disruptor like a Klingon weapon, maybe.

title: Aquiel
line: Look, we're not here to make accusations. We're trying to find out what happened. Commander Morag is due here in two hours. Let's see what he has to say.

title: Aquiel
line: Fine. In the meantime I'd like to go back to the station and see if I can access Rocha's personal logs again.

title: Aquiel
line: Good idea.

title: Aquiel
line: Geordi, wait a second. Thank you, Mister Worf.

title: Aquiel
line: Aye, sir.

title: Aquiel
line: This is off the record. I'm saying this as a friend, not your superior officer. I think it would be best if you weren't so personally involved with Aquiel right now. There's a lot about her we don't know.

title: Aquiel
line: And there's a lot about her that I do know, and if she's innocent I want to help her prove it.

title: Aquiel
line: I think you've let your personal feelings cloud your judgment.

title: Aquiel
line: I'm not the one making judgments.

title: Aquiel
line: Got it. Computer, display the personal records of Lieutenant Rocha from stardates 46455 to 46460.

title: Aquiel
line: Computer, what happened to the log entries for stardate 46459?

title: Aquiel
line: The logs have been deleted.

title: Aquiel
line: Who deleted them?

title: Aquiel
line: Unknown.

title: Aquiel
line: Captain's log, supplemental. The Qu'Vat has arrived with Commander Morag. We are preparing to question him regarding his involvement in the murder of Lieutenant Rocha.

title: Aquiel
line: I killed no one!

title: Aquiel
line: We found your DNA on the bulkheads and the console. We know you were there.

title: Aquiel
line: Answer their questions.

title: Aquiel
line: Yes. Yes, I was there. My patrol route takes me near the station every six days. Three days ago, I hailed them. There was no response. I was concerned.

title: Aquiel
line: Concerned?

title: Aquiel
line: Yes. I went aboard to see what had happened. There was no one was there, so I left.

title: Aquiel
line: Is that all?

title: Aquiel
line: That's all.

title: Aquiel
line: Commander Morag, we have discovered that the encrypted message bank on the station has been tampered with. Our analysis indicates that twenty seven priority Starfleet messages are missing.

title: Aquiel
line: What of it?

title: Aquiel
line: Your DNA was also found on the message control module.

title: Aquiel
line: This is outrageous! We will not tolerate these ridiculous accusations!

title: Aquiel
line: This is a diplomatic matter, Morag! Do not make me search your ship.

title: Aquiel
line: Yes, I did take the messages.

title: Aquiel
line: Did you kill Lieutenant Rocha?

title: Aquiel
line: No. I killed no one. There was no one there. I took the codes, but I killed no one.

title: Aquiel
line: Governor, we would like Commander Morag to remain on board the Enterprise until this investigation is complete.

title: Aquiel
line: Take him.

title: Aquiel
line: This way.

title: Aquiel
line: Last night, after I dropped you off at your quarters you established a subspace link with this console. You deleted some of Rocha's personal files, didn't you?

title: Aquiel
line: Yes, I did.

title: Aquiel
line: Why?

title: Aquiel
line: I found a letter Rocha was planning to send to Starfleet Command about me. The letter said I had become belligerent and insubordinate. He was going to ask for a formal hearing. Geordi, I know how this looks.

title: Aquiel
line: Yeah, it looks bad. I find out that you've erased a letter that contained a possible motivation for murder?

title: Aquiel
line: I didn't kill him.

title: Aquiel
line: Then explain this.

title: Aquiel
line: I was afraid if they found the letter they'd blame me for the murder. I'm not a model officer. I realize that. Sometimes I act on impulse instead of thinking things through.

title: Aquiel
line: Aquiel, this really complicates things.

title: Aquiel
line: What are you doing?

title: Aquiel
line: Getting out of here.

title: Aquiel
line: Aquiel, running away isn't going to prove your innocence. Facing the situation will.

title: Aquiel
line: I'm scared, Geordi.

title: Aquiel
line: Look, we'll get through this. I promise you, okay?

title: Aquiel
line: Then you believe me?

title: Aquiel
line: Yes, I do. Medical Officer's log, supplemental. I've isolated the cellular residue from the deck plate, but the DNA has destabilized. I'm attempting to reform it.

title: Aquiel
line: All right. Initiate the resonance frequency burst.

title: Aquiel
line: I'm starting to get a stable DNA scan. This is odd. The nucleotide sequences are starting to fluctuate. The DNA is becoming mobile. Let's try another frequency burst, but increase the resonance level by twenty percent.

title: Aquiel
line: I haven't been this close to someone in a long time. I don't want to let go of it.

title: Aquiel
line: Neither do I, but I've got six hundred logs to go through.

title: Aquiel
line: All right, but first there's something I want to share with you. A way that we can become more intimate. My people are partially telepathic. We use something called the Canar to help focus our thoughts. We also use the Canar for a stronger emotional link during love.

title: Aquiel
line: I was wondering what that was for. Do both of us have to be telepathic for it to work?

title: Aquiel
line: Let's find out.

title: Aquiel
line: Like this.

title: Aquiel
line: Think of me.

title: Aquiel
line: It's an exact reproduction of my hand, right down to the DNA structure.

title: Aquiel
line: Doctor, you said that this was formed from the organic matter found in the deck plates.

title: Aquiel
line: When I infused the matter with a resonance frequency burst, it activated its DNA. Then it touched my hand and it began to mimic my cellular structure.

title: Aquiel
line: Doctor, what exactly is this?

title: Aquiel
line: This is going to sound very farfetched, but have you ever heard of a coalescent organism?

title: Aquiel
line: No.

title: Aquiel
line: They're rare microscopic lifeforms which need to absorb other organisms in order to survive. Now, that in itself isn't so unusual, but coalescents become the organisms they've absorbed, right down to the cellular level.

title: Aquiel
line: Do you think this is what happened with your hand?

title: Aquiel
line: There've been reports that these organisms can exist on a larger scale. Certainly, what happened to my hand seems to support that theory.

title: Aquiel
line: So you think that Rocha was killed by one of these organisms?

title: Aquiel
line: It's possible that something happened to him before he reported for duty on the relay station.

title: Aquiel
line: I do not understand.

title: Aquiel
line: I've checked the records. Before he was posted to the relay station, Rocha served on an outpost in the Triona System. That is a remote sector. Maybe he was absorbed by a coalescent during that mission.

title: Aquiel
line: So what boarded the station could have been an organism that looked and acted like Lieutenant Rocha?

title: Aquiel
line: How often do they have to change bodies?

title: Aquiel
line: The microscopic organisms have a cycle of no more than five to ten seconds. We can only assume a larger, more complex coalescent would have a cycle of days, even weeks.

title: Aquiel
line: Doctor, if what you're saying is true, then Rocha attacked Lieutenant Uhnari to find a new body.

title: Aquiel
line: Right.

title: Aquiel
line: That means Uhnari is a coalescent.

title: Aquiel
line: There was one other person on the station. Morag. It is possible he was the one who was absorbed.

title: Aquiel
line: Computer, locate Commander Morag and Lieutenant Uhnari.

title: Aquiel
line: Commander Morag is in his quarters. Lieutenant Uhnari is not aboard the Enterprise.

title: Aquiel
line: Where did she go?

title: Aquiel
line: Lieutenant Uhnari transported to Relay Station forty seven at eighteen thirty hours.

title: Aquiel
line: You get Morag. I'm going to the station.

title: Aquiel
line: Aye, sir.

title: Aquiel
line: Geordi?

title: Aquiel
line: I can see you. Oh. And I can feel you.

title: Aquiel
line: Do not move.

title: Aquiel
line: What is this?

title: Aquiel
line: You will come with me.

title: Aquiel
line: You've never been as close to someone as you're about to be. Think of me.

title: Aquiel
line: Step away from him, Lieutenant.

title: Aquiel
line: What are you doing, Commander?

title: Aquiel
line: That may not be Lieutenant Uhnari.

title: Aquiel
line: What?

title: Aquiel
line: What are you saying?

title: Aquiel
line: Step away now. Medical Officer's Log, supplemental. Commander Morag and Lieutenant Uhnari are being kept under close observation. So far, no sign of coalescent behavior has surfaced.

title: Aquiel
line: Aquiel and Morag will be transferred to a secure medical facility at Starbase twelve. Maybe we'll know more by the time we get there.

title: Aquiel
line: Yeah, right.

title: Aquiel
line: It could be Morag. We don't know for sure.

title: Aquiel
line: Sure.

title: Aquiel
line: Get some rest. You've had a rough couple of days.

title: Aquiel
line: Thanks.

title: Aquiel
line: Computer, display the Engineering duty roster for the next three days.

title: Aquiel
line: Maura, come on, not now. Maura, I said not now. Come on, give me a break here. Go lay down!

title: Aquiel
line: Maura?

title: Aquiel
line: Maybe the reason you don't remember anything that happened after Rocha attacked you is that the coalescing process had begun. Thank you. Remember when you said you felt like the memories had been drained right out of you? That's probably exactly what was going on.

title: Aquiel
line: Then maybe I did take the phaser.

title: Aquiel
line: Whatever happened, at least you got away before the process took hold.

title: Aquiel
line: So he turned on Maura.

title: Aquiel
line: Right. Well, what now?

title: Aquiel
line: I guess I'll be going to Starbase two twelve for re assignment.

title: Aquiel
line: You know, I had a talk with Chief Pendleton in Communications. There's an opening for a level two specialist.

title: Aquiel
line: Really? I'm sure the waiting list so long I'd be gray before I got here.

title: Aquiel
line: I could put in a good word.

title: Aquiel
line: It's an appealing offer, but I think I'd rather get here on my own merits. Don't be surprised if you see my name on that list.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Computer, lights. Computer, turn on the lights.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Good, you're awake.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Who are you?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Please, Counselor, there is little time. The Commander will be calling for you at any moment.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Where am I?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You are aboard the Imperial Romulan Warbird Khazara. I am Subcommander N'Vek.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Warbird? I was at the neuropsychology seminar at Bokara Six. The last thing I remember was returning to my quarters. I was attacked. I felt a hypospray.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It was necessary. I could not be certain you would come voluntarily.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Oh, God. My head's still spinning.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There are drugs in your system, but they've nearly dissipated. The disorientation will soon pass.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why have you brought me here?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Listen to me carefully. You are no longer Deanna Troi. You are Major Rakal of the Tal Shiar, the Imperial Intelligence. Commander Toreth

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Am I a prisoner?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There is no time to explain everything. You must listen. Commander Toreth will want to know your mission. Tell her nothing. Simply instruct her to proceed to the Kaleb sector, heading one oh two mark four.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Kaleb sector?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Repeat it. Heading one oh two mark four.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Heading one oh two mark four. And she'll take orders from me?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You are an officer of the Tal Shiar. She will obey you. But do not push her too far.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Sub Commander N'Vek. We are approaching the loading point. Bring our guest to the Bridge.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, Commander. Immediately. Please, we must hurry.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I'm not going anywhere until you tell me what's going on.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You are a Starfleet officer disguised as a Romulan. Unless you trust me and do exactly as I have said, Toreth will discover you and you will be killed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: How do I know I won't be killed anyway?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Your only chance to get off this ship alive is to do as I say. You are an empath. You would know if I am lying. Am I?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Then let us go see the Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Orbit established, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commence loading the cargo. Notify me when the transfer is complete.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander, may I present Major Rakal of the Tal Shiar? This is Commander Toreth.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Attend to your station. Why are you here without your guards? Well?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The mission is one of utmost secrecy. I could not risk bringing guards.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: And exactly what is the nature of this clandestine assignment?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I cannot reveal that.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Oh? Why not?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I am under orders.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You don't act like a member of the Tal Shiar. How long have you been with Intelligence?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Several months.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Ah.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander, cargo is on board and secure.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Tell me, is there a reason why the Commander of a ship is being kept ignorant of its cargo?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't know what you mean.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I have been ordered to take on cargo but its contents are unknown to me. Does that seem wise? I am responsible for the safety of this ship and its crew. How do I know this cargo is safe to transport?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I'm sure it is safe, otherwise it would not have been loaded.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Ah. The Tal Shiar is deeply concerned for the safety and well-being of the military. I'm sure that every person on the Bridge of this ship could offer testimony about personal experiences with the Tal Shiar, but I doubt that many could recall those encounters as tender and caring. So I must ask you to forgive me, Major, if I hesitate to accept your assurances that that cargo presents no danger to my crew. I intend to open those containers.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That cargo is the property of the Tal Shiar. You will not touch it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: On whose authority?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Mine. And if you do not wish to undergo another personal experience with the Tal Shiar, I suggest you not question me again. Now, proceed on course bearing one oh two mark four to the Kaleb sector.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why should we go to the Kaleb sector? It's virtually deserted.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Because those are your orders.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Pilot, set course. Bearing one oh two mark four. Warp six.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain's log, stardate 46519.1. We have arrived at Research Station seventy five to take on a rather unique passenger, one whose homecoming will undoubtedly be difficult.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The man acted dishonorably. He is a traitor.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: He risked his life to get here. He spent two weeks alone in a scout ship.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That does not excuse his original actions.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Well, maybe he finally realized he made a mistake.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It's twenty years too late. Energize.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Ensign DeSeve, by order of Starfleet Command I am placing you under arrest for treason.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I understand.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: After Doctor Crusher declares you medically fit, you will be confined to your quarters until a court martial can be convened. Find some civilian clothes. I don't want to see you in that uniform.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, sir. Commander, I must speak with Captain Picard.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: He's a busy man.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Please, it's important. Urgent.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I'll tell him.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: At ease. It's Captain, actually.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Of course. I'm sorry, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You said it was important that I see you.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, Captain. I have a message from Ambassador Spock. He said it involves further cowboy diplomacy. He said you would understand. There's a Corvallen freighter arriving in the Kaleb sector in the next twelve hours. Spock wants you to rendezvous with that ship, bring its cargo back to Federation space.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What kind of cargo?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: He said it was important to the future of the Romulans and the Federation.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You have returned in order to give me this message?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Partly.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: In order to know whether Ambassador Spock's message is being delivered accurately, I need to understand something about the messenger.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I was ready to come back. Romulus had lost its appeal.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yet at one time you found something very appealing about it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Romulans are very moral, Captain. They have an absolute certainty about what is right and what is wrong, who is a friend and who is an enemy, a strict moral compass which provides them with a clarity of purpose. At one time I found their sense of purpose, their passion and commitment, to be very compelling.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: But not any more?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: As I've grown older, I realize that clarity of purpose is a more ambiguous matter than I had thought in my youth.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander Riker, set course for the Kaleb sector, warp factor eight.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye-aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You may wait outside. Make certain we're not disturbed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They're terrified of me.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The purpose of the Tal Shiar is to ensure loyalty. To defy them is to invite imprisonment or death.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I think it's time you told me what this is all about.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That is why I called you here. These are the cargo containers we brought on board earlier.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What's in it?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: He's alive. In stasis. Who is it?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Vice Proconsul M'ret of the Imperial Senate and his two top aides.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: M'ret? He's one of the highest ranking members of the Romulan government.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: His defection will be a profound blow to Romulus.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why is he doing this?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: M'ret had questioned the repressive activities of the government and was in danger of being imprisoned. He is willing to take this risk in order to protest Romulan policy and support the dissident movement.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You're part of Ambassador Spock's underground movement.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes. If we are able to deliver M'ret safely, Spock is hopeful that we can establish an escape route for the thousands of dissidents who live in fear of their lives. Now you realize why we are willing to go to such extraordinary lengths, even kidnapping you, to make sure we succeed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You've given me the identity of a Tal Shiar officer. Is there a real Major Rakal?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There was. She was killed so that you could take her place. Only a member of the Tal Shiar would have the authority to alter a ship's mission.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why me? You could have found a Romulan to play this role.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, for the first part of the plan. But if anything goes wrong we will need a Starfleet officer.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There's no need to go into that unless it becomes necessary. For your own sake, Counselor, the less you know about the specifics of this plan, the better.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What is your plan?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: When we reach the Kaleb sector, we will rendezvous with a Corvallen freighter. You will take these containers into their ship and accompany them back to Starfleet Headquarters.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Corvallens are mercenaries. Do they know what's in these containers?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No. They were hired simply to take you to Federation space.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Very well.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We are due in the ward room shortly. The senior officers always dine together.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I'll go to my quarters. I think it would be best if I stayed out of the way of the Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No, you will be expected to attend. I'll go ahead. Follow me after a few moments. Commander Toreth must not feel that anything is unusual.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We'd been told that the Klingon outpost was undefended. So when their warships decloaked, they took us completely by surprise.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Klingons managed to destroyed half my squadron before we even opened fire. But when we did, ha! they were no match for us. I destroyed their flagship myself. I received the Sotaric Citation for my actions that day. The Intelligence Officer in charge of that mission was executed. Major. Welcome to our table.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I suggest you try the viinerine. It's quite good.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I realize that it's nothing compared to what you're accustomed to on Romulus, but you could at least try the viinerine.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I've smelled better viinerine on prison ships.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No doubt. Tell me, Major, where did you train? The Intelligence Academy or the Imperial War College?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Academy.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Oh? So you must know Commander Konsab.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I know of him.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I assume you studied Military History with him?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Tell me, Major, what do you think about his theories on the differences between the military and the Tal Shiar?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Which aspects are you referring to?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Come now, Major. Surely you attended his classes regularly? It was Konsab's main theme.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Do you have a point to make, Commander? If so, it has escaped me.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander Konsab believes that in order to function, military officers have to trust each other. The Tal Shiar, on the other hand, trust no one. They expect deception, so they always find it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Your opinion of the Tal Shiar quite clear, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I hope so.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We ensure the loyalty of the people. Do you believe the Empire would be better off without our protection?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Protection? From what? How was the Empire threatened by the words of an old man, a devoted citizen who merely tried to speak his mind? How did the Tal Shiar protect the Empire by dragging him, my father, out of his home in the middle of the night?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Clearly, your father was a traitor.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No. He was just an idealistic old man. I never saw him again.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't need your devotion, Commander. Just your obedience.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: And that's all you have.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander, sensors are picking up an unidentified ship on an intercept course.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What is the configuration?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It appears to be a freighter, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Hail them.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Visual.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander. We are glad to see you. We are prepared to transfer your cargo as agreed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: With whom do you have this agreement?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Our arrangements were made with Major Rakal. You may rest assured your cargo will be taken safely to its destination. We will transmit coordinates for you to beam it aboard.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: He's lying. They have no intention of keeping their word.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Are you certain?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why did you destroy that vessel?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I beg forgiveness, Commander, but Major Rakal ordered me to fire.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Corvallen freighter has been completely destroyed, Commander. There are no survivors.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I demand an explanation.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: How many people were on that ship?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Approximately eighteen people, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't care if there were eighteen or eight hundred. On this ship, I give the command to fire, Major. You have no right.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: This gives me the right.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Even you, eventually, will have to answer to someone. You will be held accountable.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I have been given broad discretionary powers. Subcommander N'Vek acted under my authority, the authority of the Tal Shiar. I assure you this action will not be questioned.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I will nonetheless make an entry in my log that I am not responsible for those eighteen lives and that I deplore their loss.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Do what you feel is necessary. In the meantime, we must protect ourselves. Engage the cloaking device.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: And what are my orders now, Major?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Hold position and wait.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There is no sign of the freighter, sir. We are the only ship in the area.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Ensign, verify our position.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We're holding at the coordinates specified by Ensign DeSeve, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Anything on long range sensors?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Sensors indicate no other ships within three light years.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Could this have been a hoax?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It's one possibility. Mister Worf, bring Ensign DeSeve to my Ready room.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Ensign DeSeve, you promised me a freighter with an important cargo. The only thing here is empty space. Do you have an explanation?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't understand.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain, he has deceived us.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No. I was told the ship would be at these coordinates.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You said that the message came directly from Ambassador Spock.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes. Well, not exactly.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What does that mean?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Someone else relayed the message to me, but he said Spock spoke directly to him. I trust the man who spoke to me. He would not have lied.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Was he a Romulan?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes. He's a member of the underground a dissident. He risks his life to work with those who want a different future for Romulus.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain, he could be leading us into a trap.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No, that is not so.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It would be risky to set a trap here, so close to Federation space. But the fact remains, here we are, there is no freighter. Did your contact tell you anything else that might be helpful?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The freighter is an old Antares class vessel with limited speed and range. It couldn't have taken on its cargo more than a day ago which means it must be within fifteen light years of here.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Why didn't you mention this earlier?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It didn't seem necessary. And on Romulus you learn not to volunteer information. It's a hard habit to break.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Well, maybe now would be a good time to start. Follow me, gentlemen.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Our plan has collapsed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Our plan? What about the people on that freighter? Why did you fire?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There was no alternative. You told me they couldn't be trusted. If I let them live the whole mission would be in jeopardy.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Eighteen people lost their lives.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Don't lecture me, Counselor. A number of people have died in order to carry out this mission. Believe me, those eighteen won't be the last.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I'm sorry but I can't dismiss those lives so easily.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Fine. Agonize all you want, but don't let it get in the way of our plan.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You don't have a plan anymore.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You remember I told you if anything went wrong, we would need a Starfleet officer. There is a Starfleet base on Draken Four. It is two days away at maximum warp. That's where we're going.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: In a Romulan ship?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes. It's your job to order Toreth to proceed into Federation territory.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We'll never get through the gravitic sensor nets.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We will, if you provide the correct access codes.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Do you really think this has a chance of succeeding?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: If you have another idea, I'll be happy to consider it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You will plot a course for the Draken System.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You can't be serious.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Draken Four was the freighter's destination. I ordered the freighter destroyed because I recognized the Captain, a known Federation spy. Now we must deliver the cargo ourselves.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We must?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I do not intend to explain myself to you. You will set a course.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: In order to reach Draken, we will have to travel through Federation space for nearly twenty hours.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That is not a problem.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Contrary to the propaganda that your superiors would have us believe, Starfleet is neither weak nor foolish. The chances of us reaching Draken undetected are not good.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We will be cloaked.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The cloaking device does not always make us invulnerable, and you would know that if you had spent any time at all in the field. The Federation has littered it's borders with subspace listening posts, with gravitic sensors. They may even have a tachyon detection grid in operation, in which case they will know that we're there. If we are discovered in Federation territory, it will be interpreted as an act of war.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Tal Shiar has obtained access codes for the sensor nets. I will provide them if necessary.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That will be no guarantee that we will escape undetected.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Your cowardice does not befit a Romulan soldier.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: People blame the military for the wars that we are asked to fight, but I think it is your kind, Major, that will be the death of us all.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Plot a course for the Draken System.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Course plotted, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Prepare for warp.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander, sensors are picking up a vessel. Our cloaking device is still engaged. They have not detected us.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Activate viewscreen. Enlarge.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It is the Enterprise, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Well, Major, it appears your suspicions about that freighter were correct after all. The Federation has come in search of its spies. Status.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They are scanning the debris of the freighter. Shield levels are normal. Weapon systems are not active. They are not prepared for battle, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They weren't expecting to find us here, and I see no reason to alter that perception. The radiation from the debris field could make our cloak detectable if we engage warp engines. Proceed at maneuvering speed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: One moment, Commander. We should hold our position until the Enterprise has left the area. We cannot risk detection.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Even if we are detected, they cannot track us once we go to warp.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We have not established their intentions.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Their intentions are obvious, Major, and are of no concern to us. Proceed on course, maneuvering engines only. Go to warp when we're clear of the debris field.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, Commander. We should clear the field in twenty seven minutes.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You will keep me informed of our progress.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It is not wise to challenge the Tal Shiar, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I will not let her tell me how to run my ship.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It appears to be the remains of a ship. My analysis indicates that it was an Antares class freighter.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That's the ship we were supposed to meet.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Could there have had some sort of malfunction? A reactor core breach?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I do not believe so, sir. That would not be consistent with the debris pattern. However, sensors indicate extremely high levels of residual antiprotons.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Romulan disruptor fire.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Correct. Based on the antiproton decay, I would estimate the incident occurred within the last four point three hours.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Then the Romulans could still be in the vicinity.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Red alert. Shields at maximum.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Whatever that freighter was carrying, they certainly didn't want it to reach us. Are you sure you don't know what it was?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: No, sir. I swear it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: All we have here are questions. Mister Data, continue with your scan.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We have to get a message to the Enterprise.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That's impossible.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It's the perfect opportunity. The Enterprise is nearby. If we can communicate with them, they might be able to help us.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Counselor, this ship is traveling under cloak. All of our electromagnetic emissions are being monitored. Any attempt at communication whatsoever and we would be discovered instantly. It could not succeed. We must continue to Draken Four. That is the safest course.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Is there anything you can do to the ship or to the cloaking device that would let the Enterprise track us?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Track us? No. We want to get into Federation territory undetected.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What we want is to get the dissidents to safety. Now answer the question. Is there a way?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: If there were, I wouldn't do it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, you will.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Counselor.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We're not playing it your way any more, N'Vek. I've been kidnapped, surgically altered, put in danger I've gone along with all your plans. Now you are going to listen to me. You find a way to let the Enterprise track us, or I will go to Toreth and tell her I've discovered you're a traitor. I'll order you ejected into space. Is that clear, Subcommander?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: There is one possibility. In order for a ship to remain undetectable while cloaked, the radiative emissions from the warp engines must be precisely balanced. The ship's Engineer is a sympathizer. He may be able to slightly misalign one of the nullifier cores. It would create a small magnetic disturbance in space whenever we were in motion.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Good. Do it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The effect would only be intermittently. They might not even detect it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: If it's the best we can do, we have to try it.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Anything more would be immediately registered on the Bridge. Even this slight misalignment may be detected.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It's a risk we have to take. You're the one who outlined the stakes to me, N'Vek. Are you getting squeamish now, just because things are getting a little more dangerous?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Sensors are picking up a polarized magnetic distortion to our port side.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Analysis.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The distortion is extremely weak, sir. It appears to be moving slowly. It is gone, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Gone?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The distortion no longer registers on our instruments.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Could this distortion be caused by a cloaked ship?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Unknown, sir. Our understanding of Romulan technology is still limited.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain, Romulan ships use a forced quantum singularity as a power source. If that system is not functioning perfectly or is damaged even slightly, it might show through the cloak as a magnetic disturbance of some kind.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The distortion has reappeared, sir, bearing three three seven mark ten. It has disappeared again, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Mister DeSeve, in your opinion is it possible that we're picking up a cloaked Romulan ship?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It's a strong possibility, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Mister Data, continue your scan. Ensign, link navigational control to Mister Data's console and plot a course for that distortion.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander, the Enterprise is underway.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Good. What is their course?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They're heading for us, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They appear to be on an intercept course.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What is the status of our cloaking device? Is there a malfunction of any kind?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Cloaking device functioning correctly, sir. All shipboard emissions within normal range.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Maintain full sensor scans.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander. The Enterprise may simply be engaged in search operations.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Perhaps.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Where is it now, Mister Data?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It has disappeared once again, sir. I believe it may have been coming to a halt.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Stop engines.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: If this is a Romulan ship, will it stay in position until we leave?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't think so, sir. A Romulan Commander's instinct would be to attack.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Engage maneuvering engines, forward zero point one. Take us directly under their hull.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What are you doing?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It seems that the Enterprise can track us even though we are cloaked. I intend to find out whether they can or cannot. N'Vek, ready attack procedure.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Sir, disruptors are standing by. Ready to disengage cloak.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We cannot risk an engagement here.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Considering the nature of our mission, I would have preferred to have avoided it as well. But I see no other alternative.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What do you intend to do?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We will pass as close as we possibly can. If they do have the ability to track us, they will move to avoid a collision. If they do, I will destroy them.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Sir, the magnetic distortion has reappeared.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Bearing and speed?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It appears to be moving toward us, closing slowly. Its bearing indicates a possible collision course.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Time to impact?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I am unable to make a precise measurement. However I would estimate impact within ninety seconds.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: It doesn't make any sense. Why would they run into us? And if they were, why wouldn't they do it at full speed?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't know, sir. The Romulans will sometimes make suicide attacks, but only as a last resort. There's no reason for it here.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Time to impact approximately sixty seconds.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We don't have the luxury to speculate. Back us away from the distortion, Ensign. One half impulse.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They are moving away, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Prepare attack sequence.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: All sections report ready for battle, Commander.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Disruptors fully charged.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Disengage cloak on my command. Prepare to fire.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Disregard that order.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I do not authorize this attack. You will cease battle operations immediately.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I do not need your authorisation to attack, Major. This is my ship.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: How typical of the military to resort to brute force when discretion is required.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The Enterprise has demonstrated that they can track us. They must be destroyed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, they can track us. So if we attack them, they will return fire. And since we have no shields when we're cloaked, they will destroy us.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Are you questioning my ability to command?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You are not fit to command. Step down. Step down or I will have you removed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Do you think anyone here will listen to you?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: If any one of you defies the Tal Shiar, you will not bear the punishment alone. Your families, all of them, will be there beside you. I am now Commander of this ship. You will take orders from me and no one else. Remove Commander Toreth from her station. If she resists, shoot her.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Commander, please, step down.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Remove her weapon.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Now, Commander. Watch and learn. In order to defeat your enemy, you must first understand them. The Federation wishes to avoid war at all cost. So I shall offer them a diplomatic solution, get them to lower their shields and then destroy them.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain, we are being hailed.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: On screen.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I am Major Rakal of the Tal Shiar.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I am Jean-Luc Picard of the Enterprise.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: How can we be of help?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: A Corvallen freighter has been destroyed not far from here. We have detected the residual effects of disruptor fire. Can you shed any light on this?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: A regrettable incident, Captain. The freighter was fired upon by the former Commander of this vessel. I have now taken control, and I assure you there will be no more attacks.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Still, there was a considerable loss of life.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain, we do not want to exaggerate this incident. You and I can discuss it calmly. We can diffuse it before it becomes inflated.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I agree.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I will come onto your ship. Please, lower your shields and prepare to beam me aboard.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Very well. Mister Worf, lock onto Major Rakal. Transport on my command.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Thank you.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: What's she doing on that ship?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I don't know, Number One, but she needs our help to get back. Mister Worf, keep your lock on her no matter what happens.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Lower shields.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Their shields are dropping.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Activate forward disruptor array. Fire when ready.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes, Major. Firing.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Captain, they have fired on us.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Shields up. Stand by phasers. Damage report.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: We sustained a direct hit, but the damage was negligible. The disruptor had almost no power.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: This is Proconsul M'ret and his aides. They're part of the underground movement.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: They're in stasis. Medical team to the Bridge.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Where's Deanna?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Disruptors were ineffective. The Enterprise was not damaged. They have re-established full shields.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: I am reading a malfunction in our forward disruptor array. The power system has destabilized.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: You're lying. The disruptor beam has been purposely sabotaged to conceal a transporter beam within. Quickly, Pilot, locate transport coordinates. What have you done?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The transporter beam originated in our cargo bay. Something was transported from there to the Enterprise.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: So, Major, the mysterious cargo, brought on board by Major Rakal of the Tal Shiar, has been transported to the Starfleet vessel. I see two traitors in our midst.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: So, Major, now that you can no longer take refuge behind the shield of the Tal Shiar, it's time to answer a few questions. What was in those cargo containers? Well, no matter. We will soon know all we need to know, and then we will execute you. Pilot, drop shields and cloak the ship. Prepare to go to warp.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Mister Worf, now.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Counselor are you all right?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Yes.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Let's get you to Sickbay.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Ensign, get us out of here. Warp nine.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Aye, sir.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: That about does it. How does it feel to have your own face back?

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Just right. Thank you.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The men you helped rescue are safe. Proconsul M'ret is deeply grateful for your help.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: The thanks should go to N'Vek. He sacrificed himself to save them, and me.

title: Face of the Enemy
line: Thanks to the two of you, the way has been paved for further rescue operations. N'Vek's efforts, and his sacrifice, were not in vain.

title: Tapestry
line: Bring the stasis units in here, and have them online.

title: Tapestry
line: Yes, Doctor.

title: Tapestry
line: Tell Doctor Selar she can use ward three for the ambulatory cases, and I'll stay here.

title: Tapestry
line: Transporter room four to Sickbay. They're coming in now.

title: Tapestry
line: Acknowledged. Stand clear and be ready.

title: Tapestry
line: Let's go, let's go. Get him on here.

title: Tapestry
line: What happened?

title: Tapestry
line: The Lenarians attacked us outside of the conference room.

title: Tapestry
line: He's in cardiac arrest. Connect the pulmonary support units. He's got internal hemorrhaging. The bioregulator of his artificial heart's been fused. He's got liver and spleen damage. What kind of weapon caused this?

title: Tapestry
line: A compressed teryon beam.

title: Tapestry
line: Forty cc's inaprovaline. The activity in the isocortex is falling. Cortical stimulators. Now. Again. His respiratory system is shutting down. The levels in the isocortex are still falling. Damn. Prepare a four percent series

title: Tapestry
line: Welcome to the afterlife, Jean-Luc. You're dead.

title: Tapestry
line: Q, what is going on?

title: Tapestry
line: I told you. You're dead. This is the afterlife, and I'm God.

title: Tapestry
line: You are not God.

title: Tapestry
line: Blasphemy! You're lucky I don't cast you out, or smite you or something. The bottom line is, your life ended about five minutes ago, under the inept ministrations of Doctor Beverly Crusher.

title: Tapestry
line: No. I am not dead. Because I refuse to believe that the afterlife is run by you. The universe is not so badly designed.

title: Tapestry
line: Very well. If you really require more evidence of your post-mortem status, I guess I'll just have to provide you some.

title: Tapestry
line: Jean-Luc, I told you not to go running off to that Academy.

title: Tapestry
line: Father.

title: Tapestry
line: I told you that Starfleet would bring you to a bad end, but you wouldn't listen. Now look at you. Dead before your time.

title: Tapestry
line: Q, enough of this.

title: Tapestry
line: Enough what?

title: Tapestry
line: Why couldn't you have listened? Didn't you know that I was working for your best interests?

title: Tapestry
line: Q, stop this.

title: Tapestry
line: After all these years, even now, you manage to disappoint me, Jean-Luc.

title: Tapestry
line: He's not the only one who'd like to have a word with you.

title: Tapestry
line: Why, Jean-Luc? Why did you do it?

title: Tapestry
line: Captain, there are still people down there. You can't abandon them.

title: Tapestry
line: There must be some other way, Captain. Some other choice than firing on them.

title: Tapestry
line: If you continue on this course.

title: Tapestry
line: A direct hit, sir. The ship is destroyed.

title: Tapestry
line: These are the voices of all the people you've killed throughout the years.

title: Tapestry
line: Whom I've killed? What do you mean?

title: Tapestry
line: Death has made you a little dim, Jean-Luc. These are the voices of all the people who have died through your actions or your inactions. Now, if you have any words of apology or regret, I believe they're all listening. They're a surly bunch, actually, so don't drag this out too long.

title: Tapestry
line: I've no intention of performing for your amusement.

title: Tapestry
line: This is not for me. This is for you, Jean-Luc. This is your opportunity to make peace with your sordid past.

title: Tapestry
line: I find it hard to believe that you are doing this for the benefit of my soul.

title: Tapestry
line: Well, now that you've shuffled off the mortal coil, we're free to spend a little time together.

title: Tapestry
line: A little time together? How much?

title: Tapestry
line: Eternity. Now, you're sure you have no regrets or feelings of guilt about your former life? I can't have you whining and complaining through time.

title: Tapestry
line: If I'm really dead, then my only regret is dying and finding you here.

title: Tapestry
line: You wound me, Jean-Luc. After all, I was not the cause of your death. This was.

title: Tapestry
line: Is that?

title: Tapestry
line: Your artificial heart. You might have lived if you had a real one instead of this unreliable piece of technology. By the way, how did you lose yours anyway?

title: Tapestry
line: A mistake.

title: Tapestry
line: Is that a regret I hear?

title: Tapestry
line: I regret a great many things from those days.

title: Tapestry
line: Really?

title: Tapestry
line: It wasn't very smart of you to take on three Nausicaans, was it?

title: Tapestry
line: No, it wasn't.

title: Tapestry
line: And did I hear a laugh? It's so unlike you, Jean-Luc, to have a sense of humor, especially about getting stabbed through the back.

title: Tapestry
line: I was a different person in those days. Arrogant, undisciplined, with far too much ego and too little wisdom. I was more like you.

title: Tapestry
line: Then you must have been far more interesting. Pity you had to change.

title: Tapestry
line: The pity is that I had to be impaled through the back before I learned that lesson. I started that fight with those Nausicaans. I started it because, because I was young and cocky. If I'd been more responsible in those days, I wouldn't have needed this heart, and I wouldn't have died from a random energy surge thirty years later.

title: Tapestry
line: So, if you had it to do all over again?

title: Tapestry
line: Things would be different.

title: Tapestry
line: Bravo! Bravo!

title: Tapestry
line: Nicely done.

title: Tapestry
line: Cortan? Cortan Zweller?

title: Tapestry
line: Yes. Boy, she must've hit you pretty hard. Of course, you deserved it.

title: Tapestry
line: You're slowing down there, Johnny. You should've seen that one coming.

title: Tapestry
line: Marta Batanides.

title: Tapestry
line: Are you okay?

title: Tapestry
line: Yes, I'm fine. I'm just a little disoriented, that's all.

title: Tapestry
line: Come on, he's just playing for sympathy now. Look, I'm going to get something to eat and head over to the casino at Bonestell. You coming?

title: Tapestry
line: I'll catch up with you there.

title: Tapestry
line: You sure you're okay?

title: Tapestry
line: Yes, I'm fine. Really, Marta, I'm fine.

title: Tapestry
line: Come on, Marty. I bet he's got another date.

title: Tapestry
line: That's it, isn't it? You are incorrigible.

title: Tapestry
line: Try not to end up in the hospital.

title: Tapestry
line: Attention on deck, Ensign Picard.

title: Tapestry
line: Q.

title: Tapestry

title: Rightful Heir
line: Long ago, a storm was heading toward the city of Quin'lat. The people sought protection within the walls. All except one man who remained outside. I went to him and asked what he was doing. I am not afraid, he said. I will not hide my face behind stone and mortar. I will stand before the wind and make it respect me. I honored his choice and went inside. The next day, the storm came and the man was killed. The wind does not respect a fool. Do not stand before the wind, Gowron.

line: What was his name?

title: Rightful Heir
line: What?

title: Rightful Heir
line: If you were really there, you should be able to tell us the name of the man outside the walls. Describe him to us. What was he wearing? How tall was he? What color were his eyes?

title: Rightful Heir
line: I do not remember. It was long ago, and in another lifetime. What matters is, I have returned to restore faith and hope to my people. To lead them back to the way of honor and the glory that was once theirs and can be again. Is that what you oppose, Gowron?

title: Rightful Heir
line: I oppose you. I say you are not Kahless, and I will not bend my knee to you as long as I can draw a breath or pick up a blade.

title: Rightful Heir
line: No!

line: Koroth!

line: You have no joy, Gowron. Is your heart so filled of distrust and suspicion that you've forgotten what it is to be truly Klingon?

title: Rightful Heir
line: Kahless. The greatest warrior of them all.

title: Rightful Heir
line: Everything will be all right. We will say that Gowron used a dishonorable tactic in his fight with Kahless.

line: That he cheated.

title: Rightful Heir
line: That is a lie. He did not

title: Rightful Heir
line: I am Kahless, I am the strongest, the bravest warrior.

title: Rightful Heir
line: Do not think about what happened. You must think of the future, of the Empire.

title: Rightful Heir
line: There is no future here. No glorious new era for our people. Gowron was right. You did not know the name of the man who faced the storm. You do not even know what real warnog tastes like. And you certainly are not the greatest warrior of all. Whoever you are, you are not Kahless.

line: You have said enough. Now get out!

title: Rightful Heir
line: You are using the name of Kahless for some twisted game. For that alone, you should die. And if you do not tell me what you have done, I will kill you right here.

title: Rightful Heir
line: The problems with your memory are the result of the way you returned.

title: Rightful Heir
line: What do you mean?

title: Rightful Heir
line: We, the Guardians, have been awaiting your return for centuries, but we did not have the technology to bring you back. Until now. We were able to use an organic sample of the first Kahless to give you life.

title: Rightful Heir
line: A clone. He is a clone.

title: Rightful Heir
line: What is a clone?

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: You are not just a copy. We gave you more than the body of Kahless.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: You are twisting the truth.

title: Rightful Heir
line: You talk to me of truth? You, who have brought to life this lie and called it Kahless?

title: Rightful Heir
line: It is not a lie. Genetically, he is Kahless, and he is needed by our people. You know better than anyone the corruption and dishonor that has destroyed the Empire. They need him.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: How do you know that this is not the way the prophesy was to be fulfilled? Who is to say that what we did was wrong?

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: I understand your dilemma. I once had what could be considered a crisis of the spirit.

title: Rightful Heir
line: You?

title: Rightful Heir
line: Yes. The Starfleet officers who first activated me on Omicron Theta told me I was an android, nothing more than a sophisticated machine with human form. I found that difficult to accept, so I chose to believe that I was a person, that I had the potential to be more than a collection of circuits and subprocessors. It is a belief which I still hold.

title: Rightful Heir
line: How did you come to your decision?

title: Rightful Heir
line: I made a leap of faith.

title: Rightful Heir
line: The man who appeared to me on Boreth is not Kahless. He is a clone.

title: Rightful Heir
line: A clone!

title: Rightful Heir
line: Yes.

title: Rightful Heir
line: Did you really think you would get away with this kind of fraud, Koroth? I will have you and this abomination put to death.

title: Rightful Heir
line: It does not matter, Gowron. You will still not be able to stand against him.

title: Rightful Heir
line: What? He's not real. You just said so.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: I do not care what they think.

title: Rightful Heir
line: But hey are not alone. Like many of our people, they need something to believe in, just like I did. Something larger than themselves, something that will give their lives meaning. They need Kahless.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: It will not matter, Gowron. Despite the facts, they will still believe. They will make a leap of faith and there will be others just like them. Not everyone, but enough to plunge the Empire into civil war if you oppose them.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: Real power comes from within the heart. You would have the power to mold the Klingon heart. You could return them to honorable ways according to the original teachings of Kahless which are within you. It would be a great challenge, if you have the courage to accept it.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: We will tell them the truth. All of the truth. But we will tell them that even if he is not the real Kahless, he is the rightful heir to Kahless.

title: Rightful Heir
line: And if I refuse to go along with this?

title: Rightful Heir
line: Then my brother and those who support him on the Council will fight you, and I will fight you. And the Empire will fall back into civil war.

title: Rightful Heir
line: What do you say about this, Koroth?

title: Rightful Heir
line: What I say is unimportant.

title: Rightful Heir
line: It is acceptable.

title: Rightful Heir
line: Join with me, Gowron. Let us usher in this new era together.

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir

title: Rightful Heir
line: What's wrong? You should be proud of what you've accomplished.

title: Rightful Heir
line: I went to Boreth to find my faith. For a time I thought I had. But my heart is empty again. I do not know what to believe.

title: Rightful Heir
line: You doubt the real Kahless will return one day. You doubt that he is still waiting for you in Sto-Vo-Kor. Kahless left us. all of us, a powerful legacy. A way of thinking and acting that makes us Klingon. If his words hold wisdom and his philosophy is honorable, what does it really matter if he returns? What is important is that we follow his teachings. Perhaps the words are more important than the man. Q'apla, son of Mogh.

title: Rightful Heir
