line: We have taken measures to deal with our colonists who have armed themselves.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Considering that they destroyed a Juhryan freighter less than a week ago, I would say that your efforts are meeting with limited success.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain, if the Maquis are not stopped, this situation will continue to escalate to the point where the Cardassian military will have no choice but to take matters into their own hands.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain's log, supplemental. Gul Evek and his crew have left the Enterprise, and we have proceeded to our rendezvous with Admiral Nechayev.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: No Bularian canapés this time, Captain?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I thought twice was pushing it a little.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It's just as well. They're extremely fattening.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You missed Gul Evek by a matter of hours. I asked him to stay. I thought that an Admiral's assurances might convince him that we are trying to deal with this Maquis situation.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Evek manages to make the Cardassians sound like helpless sheep being preyed on by Federation wolves. The truth is, we caught the Cardassian government supplying its colonies in the Demilitarized Zone with weapons.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Gul Evek assured me that they had stopped that practice.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Ha. How comforting.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Admiral, this Maquis situation has you worried.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Believe me, Captain, if I were living that close to the Cardassians, I'd keep a phaser under my pillow too. But in the last weeks we've seen signs that the Maquis are moving beyond self-defense. Their ranks are growing. They're acquiring ships, weapons. They seem to be preparing for a more aggressive military posture. We've got to put a stop to them before the entire Demilitarized Zone ignites. But before we stop them, we have to find them. They seem to be scattered in small cells around the Zone. And we don't have reliable intelligence about any of them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Perhaps you need an undercover operative.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Our thinking exactly. We intend to infiltrate their organization, and the person we want to do it is aboard your ship right now.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Starfleet wants me to infiltrate the Maquis?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Because of your recent training, because you're Bajoran, and because of your past troubles with Starfleet gives you a certain credibility.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Well, that's certainly true. And just how soon would this mission begin?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Immediately.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I see. I've spent the better part of my life fighting the Cardassians. I never thought I'd be helping them out.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: This is a rare case when our interests and theirs coincide. We both want peace in the Demilitarized Zone.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I've heard a lot about the Maquis. One of my instructors at Tactical Training, a Lieutenant Commander in Starfleet, a man I admired and respected, he was sympathetic to them. He resigned and left to join them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're all sympathetic, Lieutenant. Our civilian population in the Demilitarized Zone is in a very difficult situation, but even sympathy has to end at some point. The peace treaty isn't just a piece of paper. If the Maquis force us into a war with Cardassia, it could mean hundreds of thousands of lives. Two years ago, Starfleet would never have tapped you for this mission. They must have a lot of confidence in you now.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The way I see it, there's one good reason to take this mission, and that's to validate your faith in me.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We are looking for a Bajoran woman, dark hair.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: She is responsible for the death of a Cardassian soldier.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: If we learn that she has been here, this establishment will be closed down.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You say she had dark hair?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Yes.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: She was here. You just missed her.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Do you know where she went?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: No.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It was really nice meeting you.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Thanks.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: So, did you kill that Cardassian?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Starfleet thinks I did. That's reason enough to hide. Why did you tell them that I'd left?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: There are worse things a person can do than kill a Cardassian soldier.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You don't often meet someone willing to say that out loud.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: In the Zone, there are a lot of us who feel that way.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'd like to meet people like that.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Don't be afraid. You're not in danger here.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What is your name?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Did you kill that Cardassian soldier?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Who are you?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're the people who saved you from Starfleet.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Thanks, but I'll be going now.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Did you kill that Cardassian?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Yes.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: That's a risky thing to do in the Demilitarized Zone. You can end up being hunted by Starfleet and the Cardassians.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Then why did he risk bringing me here?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're asking the questions. Who are you?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: My name is Ro Laren. I grew up in the Bajoran camps.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: That would explain why you have no love for Cardassians.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I know what they're capable of. They tortured my father to death and I was forced to watch.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Where are you living now?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Nowhere. I was a Starfleet officer, but I was court-martialled and sent to the stockade on Jaros Two. I'm not exactly what you'd call Starfleet material.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: When were you on Jaros?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What difference does it make?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We want to check your story. When were you there?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Starfleet let me out about three years ago because I agreed to do some work for them, mostly having to do with Bajor. But I got tired of watching them placate the Cardassians, and so I left.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You resigned?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Not officially. That's part of the reason why they're looking for me.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What were you doing on Omara?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Look, I think I've answered enough of your questions. I would like to know who you people are.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Let's say that we sympathize with those who oppose Cardassia.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Are you Maquis?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What if we were?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: If you were, I would ask if I could join you and help you fight.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We'll check your story. Go ahead, I'll keep an eye on her.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Come, let's stretch our legs.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Aren't you taking a chance by letting me see all of this? What if my story doesn't check out? What if I'm not who I say I am?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Well, then we'll have a problem, won't we?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You are Maquis, aren't you?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Many of the people here are.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Starfleet considers you outlaws. They're afraid you'll destroy the peace treaty.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: They don't understand the situation here in the Zone. I lived on Juhraya. When the treaty was signed the colony suddenly found itself in Cardassian territory. Some of us chose to stay, take our chances. Then one night I was dragged from my bed and beaten. The authorities clucked their tongues and agreed it was an unfortunate incident, and did nothing.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'm not surprised. The Cardassians intend to make life so unpleasant for Federation citizens that they'll leave.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Exactly. And no one seems to see that, except the Maquis. How old were you when your father was killed?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'd rather not talk about it.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Hungry? Would you like something?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: No, thank you.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Hasperat.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You like hasperat?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: An old Bajoran friend of mine used to make it. His was stronger. He was killed many years ago fighting the Cardassian occupation of Bajor. I miss his company, and his hasperat.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: My father used to make the strongest hasperat you've ever tasted. Everything else seems mild by comparison.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Did he teach you how to make it?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Yes. But I haven't tried it in years.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: If you would make the brine for a really strong hasperat. I mean eye watering, tongue searing strong, you'd make an old man very happy.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I would enjoy making it again.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Macias. I've checked with my sources at Starfleet. Her story's true.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I was sure it was. Kalita, she'll stay with you until we can find her a room.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Ah there you are.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We've just heard a disturbing rumor.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Another rumor?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: One that I think we should take seriously. A trader coming from Pendi Two said he could verify that the Cardassians are going to start supplying their colonists with biogenic weapons.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I thought every shipment coming into the Zone was searched.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The Cardassians always seem to find a way around problems like that.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Then we have to make a preemptive strike. Send a message to the Cardassians that we won't sit still while they kill us with toxins.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Agreed. But we can't mount a strike without medical supplies and our stockpile is dangerously low.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: If we put in a request for more, it'll draw suspicion.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I can get medical supplies. I served on the Enterprise. They always have extra medkits on hand for relief missions.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You're wanted by Starfleet. They're not going to give you medkits just because you ask for them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I have no intention of asking for them. I intend to take them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: How? The Enterprise is a fortress.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I know its security systems work. Give me a ship. I can do it.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It's madness.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We can't let her do something like this. We don't know anything about her.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I know that she can make very strong hasperat.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We need medical supplies. I think we should let her try.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: All right. But I'm going with her.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I could use an extra hand at the controls. And a witness.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I set the transporter confinement parameters to maximum. We should be able to fill our hold with medical supplies with just one single beam out.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I had no idea it was going to be so easy.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're approaching the Federation border.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: How do you plan to get out of the Demilitarized Zone without being searched at one of the checkpoints?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're going to cross the border here.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: There are sensor buoys all along the border. If we cross anywhere other than a checkpoint, Starfleet will send a ship to investigate.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: With the right security codes, we can disable the proximity detectors on the buoys.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Starfleet changes those codes all the time.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I know the encryption algorithms. If I can access the buoy's protocol subsystem I should be able to figure out the codes.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Should be able to?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Do you want this mission to succeed?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Of course I do. We need those medical supplies.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: In that case, let me do my job. I'm in.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What's wrong?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: If I don't input the right code in the next twenty seconds, we'll trigger the proximity alarm.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'm getting us out of sensor range.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Don't. If we break the comm. link, we won't be able to try again.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It worked. Until they change the access codes again, we can cross the border here.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain's log, stardate 47943.2. It has been over a week since Lieutenant Ro left the Enterprise. We have yet to receive any communication from her.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We picked up a request for emergency assistance from a Federation science ship in the Topin system.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Are there any other ships in the vicinity?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're the closest.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Helm, set course for the Topin system. Mister Data, will you signal the science ship that we're on our way.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It is unlikely that they would receive our communication, sir. The Topin system contains an unstable protostar. It generates significant magnetoscopic interference.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Can we use our sensors to find them?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Most of our sensors would be ineffective, although our directional array should cut through the interference.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: That array has such a narrow scan field. We might as well break out the palm beacons and try to find them that way.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: This is insane. We're sitting here, no sensors, blind to the outside, waiting for a galaxy class Starship to come swooping down on us.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Don't worry. It'll be hard for them to locate us with just the directional sensors. Besides, they're looking for a damaged science ship that wants to be found. They're here. Standby to engage thrusters.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Anything?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: No, sir. It will take approximately six hours to scan this system.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain, the distress call is being repeated.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Data, can you locate the signal?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I am attempting to do so.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: They're scanning our last position.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: All right, I've locked onto their sensor beam. I'm going to use it to maneuver into transporter range.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: How are we going to beam through their shields?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We can't. If we're going to get those medical supplies, we're going to have to take this ship through their shields.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Sir, I am scanning the area from which the distress signal was sent, but I am unable to detect a vessel.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain, the computer has detected a piggyback communication on the last distress signal.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Can you decode it?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It will take a few moments.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Do it.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The Enterprise shields have a weak point. When the ship is at impulse, the thrust destabilizes the shield configuration right at this point. I'm going to try to punch through there.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Won't they detect us?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: They'll know something's penetrated the shields. With all the interference it'll take them a few seconds to find us. We'll have to beam the medical supplies aboard and get out fast.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The message is difficult to decode. Interference has garbled much of the transmission, but it seems to be from Lieutenant Ro.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Ro is on that ship?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Sir, a vessel of some kind is attempting to penetrate our aft shields.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Let it through.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We're going to make it. All right, we're in.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Energizing.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Let's get out of here.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain, a quantity of medical supplies was beamed from cargo bay seven.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The vessel that penetrated our shields is of the same design as the ships used by the Maquis. It is moving off.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Let it go. There must be someone with her. We should make it look as though we're trying to stop them. Mister Worf, lock phasers on their previous position and fire.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Aye, sir.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Now we know what they mean by Advanced Tactical Training.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You took your ship through their shields?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Ro parked us between their warp nacelles. I thought she was crazy, but it worked. She knew exactly what she was doing.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Well done.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I have to inventory supplies and find out what we have.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: See you later.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Well, it seems that Kalita has decided you're not a Federation spy after all. She's suspicious of everyone at first. And rightly so. We've learned to be cautious with strangers.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I understand.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: But I've known since I first met you that in your heart, you're one of us.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain's log, supplemental. Having earned the Maquis' trust with her raid on the Enterprise, Lieutenant Ro has been given access to a ship and allowed to leave the settlement by herself.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: There are rumors that the Cardassians are supplying their colonists with biogenic weapons.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Frankly, I find it hard to believe. Every ship that enters the Demilitarized Zone is being searched.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The Maquis are convinced that the Cardassians are finding a way around these searches.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You know, we could make use of that.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Sir?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We have come up with a plan that has the potential to seriously curtail the Maquis. We want to give them a target so threatening to them that they'll be willing to commit as many ships and people as possible in order to destroy it.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What do you mean, give them a target?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Biogenic weapons, for example. You could provide them with intelligence that would show that the Cardassians are, in fact, supplying their colonists with them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: That would get their attention, all right.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You could tell them that in order to get past the check points, they're shipping the components for these weapons through third parties, and then we could put together a convoy and send it toward the Demilitarized Zone.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: And when the Maquis attack it, Starfleet will be waiting for them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We could station our ships in the Hugora Nebula to avoid detection.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Basically, I would be leading them into a trap.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: That's right. If you have a problem with any of this, I need to know it now.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Well, if I do, sir, it will not stop me from carrying out my duty.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I knew that I could count on you.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It took me a while, but I managed to patch through into Starfleet's comm. system. I intercepted a communication from one of the checkpoints on the border. They're concerned because a Pakled transport came through carrying retro-viral vaccines.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Why is that a concern?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Well, last week a Ferengi transport came through carrying biomimetic gels. By themselves, neither of these is dangerous, but Starfleet is concerned because with along with other components the Cardassians could put together a biogenic device.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What is Starfleet going to do about it?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: They can't do anything about it. These items are all perfectly legal.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: How close are the Cardassians to having the components they need?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Very close. Two days ago, a Yridian convoy left Deep Space Nine for the Demilitarized Zone. It's carrying isomiotic hypos, plasma flares and quarantine pods.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We can't let that convoy reach its destination.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: But it's too big for us to go after alone.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'll discuss the situation with the other cell leaders. Considering what's at stake, they'll want to help.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I've sent a communication to the others. When this is over, we'll celebrate.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: When it's over?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: When Cardassia realizes they can't intimidate us into leaving our colonies.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Something tells me it'll be a long time before we'll be celebrating.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Don't be discouraged, Ro. It'll take time, but the important thing is that we not give up.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I spent ten years in the camps. I don't give up.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I've been thinking a long time about what our celebration will be like. We'll have a huge dinner. You'll make hasperat and I'll make blueberry pie. We'll drink wine and we'll dance. I'll even play the belaklavion. That'll give everyone a laugh.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: You play the klavion?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Yes, badly. It's a difficult instrument, but I enjoy the challenge.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: My father played the klavion. When I was very young and afraid of monsters under my bed, he'd play for me. He said that the klavion had special powers. Monsters were afraid of it and when they heard it they would disappear. When I listened to that music he played for me I was never afraid to go to sleep. When he died I realized even he couldn't make all the monsters go away.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Why wait? Let's go to the market. Let's get food for a feast, for a celebration.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: A celebration of what?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Of absolutely nothing. Just to celebrate.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'd like that.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Come, let's go to the market. If I'm going to make a pie, we'll have to find a substitute for blueberries. Haven't seen real ones in years.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: On Bajor, there's a berry

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Yes, I know it, very sweet.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Ro!

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Macias?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: They must have found out that there was a Maquis cell here.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Kalita, get one of the medkits. Hurry. You have to hang on.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: When an old fighter like me dies someone always steps forward to take his place.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Not tonight. Hello. Are you alone?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I hope not.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Why don't we get acquainted? There's a table in the back that's more private.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'd like that.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We have to cancel the mission.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Why?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The Maquis didn't go for the bait. They think the convoy is too big a target.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: But there are only six ships. We could even cut back that number.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It's the commitment of resources, of grouping so many of the Maquis together at once. They feel that it makes them too vulnerable.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Every intelligence report that I get from Starfleet suggests that the Maquis are eager to expand their strikes, they want to escalate their activities. Now you're telling me this isn't true?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: It's probably different in every cell. The people I've met tend to be more conservative. I'm sure others have a more militant attitude.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Laren, what's going on?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Do you have the money I asked you to bring?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Yes.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Put some on the table.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: By this time, you should be negotiating my price. When you sent me on this mission, I thought that I could do it. Even though it meant helping Cardassians, even though it meant betraying people who are fighting against them. Now I'm not sure where I stand.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Are you saying you want to back out of this mission?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Sir, I don't want to let you down, I swear that I don't.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: This has nothing to do with me. This is about you. If you back out now, you'll throw away everything you've worked for. We're committed to this mission. My only question for you is, can you carry out your orders? I could put you before a board of inquiry for having lied to me about this operation. I would certainly have you court-martialled if you sabotage it. Now, it's your decision.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'll carry out my orders, sir.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I feel it necessary to have Commander Riker go back with you. He can pose as a relative. I just want to make sure that nothing happens to obstruct this mission.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'm sorry. I don't have that kind of money.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain's log, supplemental. We have received word from Commander Riker and Lieutenant Ro that the Maquis will be attacking the convoy as planned. Our ships have taken up position in the Hugora Nebula to wait for them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I have established a relay link with the sensor probe we left on the perimeter of the Nebula. This is the convoy. We are expecting the Maquis attack force to cross the border from the Demilitarized Zone.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: As soon as they cross the border, we'll intercept them.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Captain, in order to ensure that the ship Commander Riker and Lieutenant Ro are piloting does not come under fire, I have relayed their warp signature to the rest of the attack force.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Sir, the Maquis squadron is coming into sensor range.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Go to Red alert.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Aye, sir.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Squad leader to all ships.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Go ahead, squad leader.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We'll be crossing the border in less than one minute. Arm your weapons.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Acknowledged.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Starfleet can't make its move until we're out of the Demilitarized Zone. We're to break formation and take cover in the Nebula as soon as they appear.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The ships in the convoy are raising their shields. They've spotted us.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: We cross the border in thirty seconds.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What the?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I'm sorry. I can't let this happen.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Sir, the vessel being piloted by Lieutenant Ro is firing a low intensity particle beam into the nebula.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: What the hell is she doing?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: The polarizing effect being created by the beam may make it possible for us to be detected.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Can you counter the effect?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: I will attempt to do so.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Ro, why are you firing?

title: Preemptive Strike
line: Scan the nebula.

title: Preemptive Strike
line: There's a Starfleet attack force hiding inside it.

title: Preemptive Strike
